<script>
(() => {
  const $ = (s) => document.querySelector(s);
  const $$ = (s) => [...document.querySelectorAll(s)];
  // Static overlays predate the Promise-based dialog helper. Give them the same baseline contract:
  // announced open/closed state, trapped focus, Escape where cancellation is safe, and focus return.
  const staticModalState = new WeakMap();
  const topModal = () => [...document.querySelectorAll('.modal-bg:not(.hidden)')].at(-1);
  const syncStaticModal = (bg) => {
    const open = !bg.classList.contains('hidden');
    const prior = staticModalState.get(bg) || {};
    bg.setAttribute('aria-hidden', String(!open));
    if (open && !prior.open) {
      prior.returnFocus = document.activeElement;
      document.body.classList.add('modal-open');
      requestAnimationFrame(() => {
        const panel = bg.querySelector('.modal');
        if (topModal() === bg && !panel.contains(document.activeElement))
          (focusableIn(panel)[0] || panel)?.focus({ preventScroll: true });
      });
    } else if (!open && prior.open) {
      if (!document.querySelector('.modal-bg:not(.hidden)')) document.body.classList.remove('modal-open');
      if (prior.returnFocus?.isConnected && !prior.returnFocus.closest('.hidden, [hidden]')
        && (!topModal() || topModal().contains(prior.returnFocus)))
        prior.returnFocus.focus({ preventScroll: true });
    }
    prior.open = open;
    staticModalState.set(bg, prior);
  };
  const staticModals = $$('.modal-bg:not([data-managed-dialog])');
  staticModals.forEach((bg) => {
    syncStaticModal(bg);
    new MutationObserver(() => syncStaticModal(bg)).observe(bg, { attributes: true, attributeFilter: ['class'] });
  });
  document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
    const bg = topModal();
    if (!bg || !staticModals.includes(bg)) return;
    const panel = bg.querySelector('.modal');
    if (e.key === 'Escape' && !bg.hasAttribute('data-modal-lock')) {
      e.preventDefault(); e.stopPropagation();
      const close = bg.dataset.modalClose;
      if (close === 'self') bg.classList.add('hidden');
      else if (close) $(close)?.click();
      return;
    }
    if (e.key !== 'Tab') return;
    const items = focusableIn(panel);
    if (!items.length) { e.preventDefault(); panel?.focus(); return; }
    const first = items[0], last = items[items.length - 1];
    if (e.shiftKey && (document.activeElement === first || !items.includes(document.activeElement))) { e.preventDefault(); last.focus(); }
    else if (!e.shiftKey && (document.activeElement === last || !items.includes(document.activeElement))) { e.preventDefault(); first.focus(); }
  }, true);

  // lang= stamp invited Chrome's Google Translate to machine-translate the English game prose,
  // which mangles the noir jargon and breaks the live-updating DOM). A language is applied ONLY

  I18N.en.t_world = 'Command Center';
  const LANG = (() => {
    const saved = localStorage.getItem('omerta_lang');
    return (saved && I18N[saved]) ? saved : 'en';
  })();
  const T = (k) => (I18N[LANG] && I18N[LANG][k]) || I18N.en[k] || k;
  if (I18N[LANG]?.rtl) document.documentElement.dir = 'rtl';
  document.documentElement.lang = LANG;
  function applyI18n() {
    for (const n of $$('[data-i18n]')) n.textContent = T(n.dataset.i18n);
    for (const n of $$('[data-i18n-ph]')) n.placeholder = T(n.dataset.i18nPh);
  }
  function mountLangPicker(sel) {
    const host = $(sel); if (!host) return;
    // (AUDIT-full-product #5) the packs translate the CHROME - menus, labels, buttons. The game's
    // prose (the coach, the glossary, action results, the codex) is written in English by design, so
    // the picker says so rather than over-promising a fully localised game.
    const pick = el(`<select class="langpick" title="Language - menus only (the game text stays English) / Idioma - solo men�s / ?? - ???">${Object.entries(I18N)
      .map(([k, v]) => `<option value="${k}"${k === LANG ? ' selected' : ''}>${esc(v.name)}${k === 'en' ? '' : ' (menus)'}</option>`).join('')}</select>`);
    pick.onchange = () => { localStorage.setItem('omerta_lang', pick.value); location.reload(); };
    host.appendChild(el('<span class="langglobe" title="Language - menus only" style="opacity:.65;margin-left:8px;font-size:14px">??</span>')); // (C15) a language affordance
    host.appendChild(pick);

  const el = (h) => { const d = document.createElement('div'); d.innerHTML = h; return d.firstElementChild; };
  // `toLocaleString` with no options runs to THREE fraction digits, which is wrong at both ends of
  // what this formats. Cash: bank interest accrues sub-cent, so a balance rendered "$5,005,065.955"
  // - three decimals on money, and a precision the sheet never shows. $OMR: it is a 6dp token, so
  // a real dust balance of 0.00021 rendered as a flat "0" - a non-zero payment reported as nothing.
  // Two decimals is right for money and fine for the token; below a cent, show two significant
  // figures so dust reads as dust instead of as zero.
  const fmt = (n) => {
    const v = Number(n);
    if (!Number.isFinite(v)) return String(n);
    if (v !== 0 && Math.abs(v) < 0.01) return Number(v.toPrecision(2)).toString();
    return v.toLocaleString('en-US', { maximumFractionDigits: 2 });
  };
  // Module scope on purpose: renderStart AND renderMap both print watch/prime-time hours - a copy
  // local to one renderer is a ReferenceError in the other (The Map went blank the moment any
  // district declared a watch hour; fixtures never declare one, which is why guards stayed green).
  const ptHour = (h) => `${String(h).padStart(2, '0')}:00 UTC`;
  // ordinals for the blood count ("the 3rd body between your bloodlines")
  const nth = (n) => { const s = ['th', 'st', 'nd', 'rd'], v = n % 100; return `the ${n}${s[(v - 20) % 10] || s[v] || s[0]}`; };
  // �� polish layer: haptics + tactile feedback (progressive enhancement - silent no-ops where unsupported;
  // iOS Safari has no Vibration API, Android/Chrome does; reduced-motion users get none by choice) ��
  const REDUCED = matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;
  // THE MOTION SET - which art plates have a living ambient clip, and which ambient beds shipped.
  // Fetched from the server's own boot allowlist (/v1/art/motion), so the client hardcodes nothing
  // and a clip added tomorrow is alive the day it ships. Empty until the fetch lands = stills only.
  const MOTION = { clips: new Set(), beds: new Set() };
  const motionOK = () => !REDUCED && !navigator.connection?.saveData;
  (async () => { try { const r = await fetch('/v1/art/motion'); const j = await r.json();
    (j.clips || []).forEach((c) => MOTION.clips.add(c)); (j.beds || []).forEach((b) => MOTION.beds.add(b)); } catch { /* stills stand in */ } })();
  // mount a living clip over a still - shared by the tab plate, card art and the vignette. The
  // still stays as the poster, so a clip that never loads/plays leaves the photograph (fail-safe).
  const liveVideo = (key, cls, poster) => {
    const v = document.createElement('video');
    v.className = cls; v.muted = true; v.loop = true; v.playsInline = true; v.autoplay = true;
    if (poster) v.poster = poster;
    v.src = `/art/hype/${key}.mp4`;
    v.onerror = () => v.remove();
    v.play?.()?.catch?.(() => {});
    return v;
  };
  // HOVER-TO-LIVE - any card art (img.ico) whose plate has a motion clip swaps to the clip the
  // moment the pointer (or a finger) lands on it, poster = the still, capped at 5 concurrent so a
  // wandering pointer can't leave a dozen videos running. A re-render naturally resets everything.
  const liveCards = [];
  document.addEventListener('pointerover', (e) => {
    if (!motionOK()) return;
    const img = e.target;
    // an element that DECLARES its motion key (a card whose art is a CSS background) mounts a
    // backdrop clip instead of a swap - same cap, same fail-safe
    const host = (img.closest?.('[data-mkey]'));
    if (host && !host.querySelector('.cardvid') && MOTION.clips.has(host.dataset.mkey)) {
      const bv = liveVideo(host.dataset.mkey, 'cardvid');
      host.prepend(bv); liveCards.push(bv);
      while (liveCards.length > 5) { const old = liveCards.shift(); if (old.isConnected) (old._still ? old.replaceWith(old._still) : old.remove()); }
      return;
    }
    if (!(img instanceof HTMLImageElement) || !img.classList.contains('ico')) return;
    const key = (/\/v1\/art\/([a-z]+)\/([a-z0-9_-]+)/i.exec(img.src) || []).slice(1).join('-') ||
                (/\/art\/([a-z0-9_-]+)\.jpg/i.exec(img.src) || [])[1];
    if (!key || !MOTION.clips.has(key)) return;
    const v = liveVideo(key, img.className, img.src);
    v._still = img;
    img.replaceWith(v);
    liveCards.push(v);
    while (liveCards.length > 5) { const old = liveCards.shift(); if (old.isConnected) old.replaceWith(old._still); }
  }, { passive: true });
  const HAPTIC = { tap: 8, success: [12, 30, 14], error: [40, 60, 40], big: [18, 40, 18, 40, 70] };
  const haptic = (kind) => { if (REDUCED) return; try { navigator.vibrate?.(HAPTIC[kind] || 8); } catch {} };
  // �� THE SOUNDTRACK (task #307, founder: "addition of sounds when playing and when clicking .
  // addictive tones . fit the mafia theme"). WebAudio-SYNTHESIZED - zero assets, zero deps,
  // license-free, so the single-file console stays self-contained. The context is created lazily
  // on the first user gesture (autoplay policy); a ?? top-bar toggle persists the mute; every path
  // is try/caught so a browser with no (or a broken) AudioContext degrades to SILENCE, never an
  // error. Deliberately NOT gated on prefers-reduced-motion - motion is not sound, and the audio
  // has its own switch. The palette is the noir room: felt-damped clicks, a register's coin chime,
  // a rising minor sting for the big moments, a cell door for lockup.
  const SFX = (() => {
    let ctx = null, master = null;
    const enabled = () => localStorage.getItem('omerta_sfx') !== 'off';
    const ensure = () => {
      try {
        if (!ctx) {
          const AC = window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext; if (!AC) return false;
          ctx = new AC();
          const comp = ctx.createDynamicsCompressor();
          master = ctx.createGain(); master.gain.value = 0.28;
          master.connect(comp); comp.connect(ctx.destination);
        }
        if (ctx.state === 'suspended') ctx.resume();
        return ctx.state !== 'closed';
      } catch { return false; }
    };
    // one voice: a tone with optional pitch glide + exponential decay through an optional lowpass
    const tone = (t0, { f, f2, dur = 0.15, type = 'sine', g = 0.5, lp = 0 }) => {
      const o = ctx.createOscillator(), env = ctx.createGain();
      o.type = type; o.frequency.setValueAtTime(f, t0);
      if (f2) o.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(f2, t0 + dur);
      env.gain.setValueAtTime(0.0001, t0);
      env.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(g, t0 + 0.008);
      env.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, t0 + dur);
      let head = o;
      if (lp) { const fl = ctx.createBiquadFilter(); fl.type = 'lowpass'; fl.frequency.value = lp; o.connect(fl); head = fl; }
      head.connect(env); env.connect(master);
      o.start(t0); o.stop(t0 + dur + 0.02);
    };
    const noise = (t0, { dur = 0.06, g = 0.3, hp = 1200, lp = 0 }) => {
      const n = Math.max(1, Math.floor(ctx.sampleRate * dur));
      const buf = ctx.createBuffer(1, n, ctx.sampleRate);
      const d = buf.getChannelData(0);
      for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) d[i] = (Math.random() * 2 - 1) * (1 - i / n);
      const src = ctx.createBufferSource(); src.buffer = buf;
      const env = ctx.createGain(); env.gain.value = g;
      let head = src;
      const f1 = ctx.createBiquadFilter(); f1.type = 'highpass'; f1.frequency.value = hp; head.connect(f1); head = f1;
      if (lp) { const f2c = ctx.createBiquadFilter(); f2c.type = 'lowpass'; f2c.frequency.value = lp; head.connect(f2c); head = f2c; }
      head.connect(env); env.connect(master);
      src.start(t0);
    };
    // the vocabulary - each a tiny score played at "now". Kept SMALL on purpose: a sound on every
    // event teaches the ear to ignore all of them (the cinematic-rarity lesson, in audio).
    const SOUNDS = {
      click: (t) => { noise(t, { dur: 0.018, g: 0.10, hp: 2500 }); tone(t, { f: 1600, dur: 0.03, g: 0.05 }); },
      ok:    (t) => { tone(t, { f: 660, dur: 0.07, g: 0.09 }); tone(t + 0.06, { f: 880, dur: 0.09, g: 0.09 }); },
      cash:  (t) => { tone(t, { f: 1318.5, dur: 0.09, g: 0.15, type: 'triangle' }); tone(t + 0.07, { f: 1975.5, dur: 0.16, g: 0.13, type: 'triangle' }); noise(t, { dur: 0.03, g: 0.05, hp: 4000 }); },
      win:   (t) => { [220, 261.6, 329.6, 440].forEach((f, i) => tone(t + i * 0.09, { f, dur: 0.22, g: 0.13, type: 'triangle' })); tone(t + 0.36, { f: 880, dur: 0.5, g: 0.09 }); },
      bad:   (t) => { tone(t, { f: 130, f2: 70, dur: 0.18, g: 0.15, type: 'square', lp: 400 }); noise(t, { dur: 0.05, g: 0.07, hp: 300, lp: 1200 }); },
      jail:  (t) => { [187, 463, 747, 1123].forEach((f) => tone(t, { f, dur: 0.55, g: 0.06, type: 'triangle' })); noise(t, { dur: 0.08, g: 0.13, hp: 700 }); },
      ring:  (t) => { tone(t, { f: 1046.5, dur: 0.12, g: 0.08 }); tone(t + 0.15, { f: 1046.5, dur: 0.12, g: 0.06 }); },
    };
    // HAPTICS - the client already has an explicit haptic() vocabulary at the chosen sites
    // (tap/success/error/big), so the per-sound buzz covers ONLY the sounds no site pairs with a
    // haptic() call - ok (an action landed), cash (money moved), jail, ring - or the two systems
    // would double-fire on the same beat (the champion moment pairs sfx('win') + haptic('big')).
    const BUZZ = { ok: [12], cash: [12, 40, 12], jail: [70, 50, 70], ring: [30, 80, 30] };
    const play = (name) => {
      if (!enabled() || !SOUNDS[name]) return;
      try { if (BUZZ[name]) navigator.vibrate?.(BUZZ[name]); } catch { /* not supported */ }
      try { if (!ensure()) return; SOUNDS[name](ctx.currentTime); } catch { /* silence, never an error */ }
    };
    return { play, enabled, toggle() { localStorage.setItem('omerta_sfx', enabled() ? 'off' : 'on'); return enabled(); } };
  })();
  // THE AMBIENT ENGINE - a low generated bed under each part of town (rain over the streets, brushed
  // jazz in the den, a foghorn at the docks), crossfaded when you move. Same switch as the SFX (one
  // "game feel" toggle), gated behind the first gesture (autoplay policy), paused with a hidden tab,
  // and silence - never an error - when a bed didn't ship or won't play.
  const AMBIENT = (() => {
    const TAB_BED = { den: 'bed-den', speakeasy: 'bed-speakeasy', port: 'bed-docks', law: 'bed-law', pen: 'bed-pen', portfolio: 'bed-legit' };
    const GROUP_BED = { streets: 'bed-streets', earners: 'bed-streets', city: 'bed-streets', start: 'bed-streets',
      vice: 'bed-den', blood: 'bed-law', family: 'bed-family', legit: 'bed-legit' };
    let cur = null, curKey = null, wantKey = null, gestured = false, fadeT = null;
    const VOL = 0.11;
    const fadeTo = (a, target, ms, done) => { clearInterval(fadeT); const step = (target - a.volume) / (ms / 60);
      fadeT = setInterval(() => { try { a.volume = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, a.volume + step)); } catch {}
        if ((step > 0 && a.volume >= target) || (step < 0 && a.volume <= Math.max(0, target))) { clearInterval(fadeT); done?.(); } }, 60); };
    const stop = () => { if (cur) { const dying = cur; fadeTo(dying, 0, 900, () => { dying.pause(); dying.src = ''; }); cur = null; curKey = null; } };
    const start = (key) => {
      const a = new Audio(`/art/hype/${key}.m4a`);
      a.loop = true; a.preload = 'auto'; a.volume = 0;
      const p = a.play?.();
      p?.then?.(() => fadeTo(a, VOL, 1400))?.catch?.(() => { /* pre-gesture - retried on the next pointerdown */ });
      cur = a; curKey = key;
    };
    const sync = () => {
      const ok = SFX.enabled() && !navigator.connection?.saveData && !document.hidden && gestured;
      const key = ok && wantKey && MOTION.beds.has(wantKey) ? wantKey : null;
      if (key === curKey) { if (cur && cur.paused && key) cur.play?.()?.catch?.(() => {}); return; }
      stop(); if (key) start(key);
    };
    document.addEventListener('pointerdown', () => { if (!gestured) { gestured = true; sync(); } }, { capture: true, passive: true });
    document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', () => { if (document.hidden) cur?.pause(); else sync(); });
    return { set(tabId, grp) { wantKey = TAB_BED[tabId] || GROUP_BED[grp] || null; sync(); }, sync };
  })();
  const sfx = (n) => SFX.play(n);
  // every button press gets the felt-damped click (pointerdown so it lands on the GESTURE - which
  // is also what unlocks the AudioContext); disabled buttons never fire pointer events
  document.addEventListener('pointerdown', (e) => {
    if (e.target?.closest?.('button.act, .tab, .grp, .bn')) sfx('click');
  }, { passive: true });
  // one delegated listener arms every button in the app with a touch tick - no per-site wiring.
  // It also remembers WHICH button was pressed, so a payout can float up from the control that
  // earned it rather than from the middle of the screen (the render replaces innerHTML, so the
  // element itself may be gone by then - floatVal reads its rect at press time, not at result time).
  let lastPressed = null, lastPressRect = null;
  document.addEventListener('pointerdown', (e) => {
    const b = e.target?.closest?.('button, [data-do]');
    if (!b) return;
    lastPressed = b;
    try { lastPressRect = b.getBoundingClientRect(); } catch { lastPressRect = null; }
    haptic('tap');
  }, { passive: true });
  // Receipts follow the actual activation, including Enter/Space and form submission. Pointer
  // history is only for visual feedback; a later programmatic move must not inherit an old label.
  let activatedControl = null, activationRevision = 0;
  function noteActivation(control) {
    const revision = ++activationRevision;
    activatedControl = control?.isConnected ? control : null;
    setTimeout(() => { if (revision === activationRevision) activatedControl = null; }, 0);
  }
  document.addEventListener('click', (event) => {
    noteActivation(event.target?.closest?.('button, [data-do], [role="button"]'));
  }, true);
  document.addEventListener('submit', (event) => noteActivation(event.submitter), true);

  // �� GAME FEEL �������������������������������������������������������������������
  // A short vocabulary of physical feedback, so a result LANDS instead of appearing.
  // All four are no-ops under prefers-reduced-motion - that setting means off, not less.

  // the whole frame takes the hit. Violence and busts only: shaking the screen for a
  // PAYOUT reads as an error, which is the opposite of what a payday should feel like.
  function shake() {
    if (REDUCED) return;
    document.body.classList.remove('shaking');
    void document.body.offsetWidth;              // reflow, or a second shake in a row never plays
    document.body.classList.add('shaking');
    setTimeout(() => document.body.classList.remove('shaking'), 520);
  }
  // one frame of colour across everything - a muzzle flash, a flashbulb, a payday
  let flashEl = null;
  function flash(colour) {
    if (REDUCED) return;
    if (!flashEl) { flashEl = document.createElement('div'); flashEl.id = 'flashwrap'; document.body.appendChild(flashEl); }
    flashEl.style.background = colour;
    flashEl.classList.remove('go'); void flashEl.offsetWidth; flashEl.classList.add('go');
  }
  // a number that rises off the thing that produced it. Anchored to the element the
  // player just touched, so the payoff appears where their attention already is.
  function floatVal(text, good = true, anchor = null) {
    if (REDUCED || !text) return;
    // the rect is captured at PRESS time (lastPressRect): by the time a result lands the
    // handler has usually re-rendered the tab, so the button that was touched no longer exists.
    const r = (anchor && document.body.contains(anchor) ? anchor.getBoundingClientRect() : null) || lastPressRect;
    const n = el(`<div class="floatval" style="color:${good ? 'var(--ok)' : 'var(--bad)'}">${esc(text)}</div>`);
    n.style.left = `${(r ? r.left + r.width / 2 : innerWidth / 2) - 40}px`;
    n.style.top = `${(r ? r.top : innerHeight / 2) - 8}px`;
    document.body.appendChild(n);
    setTimeout(() => n.remove(), 1200);
  }

  // �� THE CINEMATIC ��������������������������������������������������������������
  // A title card for the handful of moments worth stopping for. Deliberately rare:
  // fire it on every crime and players learn to look away from it, which costs you
  // the one tool you had for the moments that DO matter.
  let cineEl = null, cineT = null;
  // THE MOTION LIBRARY - which ambient clip backs which KIND of moment. Generated Seedance loops that
  // ship in the repo (/art/hype/*.mp4, served off the boot allowlist). Keyed by the spec's fx (the
  // same tag that picks the sting), with a couple of context overrides; anything unmapped gets no
  // video, which is most things, on purpose - the rarity rule that keeps the big moments big.
  const CINE_CLIPS = {
    violent: ['cine-whacked.mp4', 'hitman-professional.mp4', 'hitman-legbreaker.mp4', 'crime-torch.mp4'],   // a kill / the first-blood beat
    payday: ['cine-payday.mp4', 'crime-counting.mp4', 'crime-diamond.mp4', 'heist-goldvault.mp4', 'crime-vaultjob.mp4'], // money in hand
    jail: ['interior-law.mp4', 'interior-pen.mp4'],            // the pinch
    escape: ['district-docks.mp4'],        // over the wall
    title: ['cine-champion.mp4', 'hero-backdrop.mp4', 'crest.mp4'],  // the belt / a crowned moment
  };
  let cineClipN = 0; // rotate within a moment's set so back-to-back cinematics don't repeat a clip
  function cine(spec) {
    if (REDUCED || !spec) return;
    if (!cineEl) {
      cineEl = el('<div id="cine"><div class="cbox"></div></div>');
      cineEl.onclick = () => closeCine();               // touching anywhere skips it
      document.body.appendChild(cineEl);
    }
    const { kicker = '', title, sub = '', lines = [], accent = 'var(--neon)', glow = 'var(--neon-glow)' } = spec;
    cineEl.style.setProperty('--cine-accent', accent);
    cineEl.style.setProperty('--cine-glow', glow);
    // mount/replace the backdrop clip for this moment (absent = none; a failed load self-removes so
    // the card never shows a broken video frame)
    cineEl.querySelector('.cvid')?.remove();
    const set = CINE_CLIPS[spec.fx];
    const clipFile = spec.clip || (set ? set[cineClipN++ % set.length] : null);
    if (clipFile) {
      const v = el(`<video class="cvid" src="/art/hype/${clipFile}" muted autoplay loop playsinline></video>`);
      v.onerror = () => v.remove();
      v.play?.()?.catch?.(() => {});
      cineEl.appendChild(v);
    }
    cineEl.firstElementChild.innerHTML = `
      ${kicker ? `<div class="ckicker">${esc(kicker)}</div>` : ''}
      <div class="ctitle">${esc(title)}</div>
      <div class="crule"></div>
      ${sub ? `<div class="csub">${esc(sub)}</div>` : ''}
      ${lines.length ? `<div class="clines">${lines.map((l, i) =>
        `<span style="animation-delay:${.45 + i * .13}s">${esc(l)}</span>`).join('')}</div>` : ''}
      <div class="cskip">tap to continue</div>`;
    cineEl.classList.add('on');
    clearTimeout(cineT); cineT = setTimeout(closeCine, spec.hold || 2100);
  }
  function closeCine() { clearTimeout(cineT); cineEl?.classList.remove('on'); cineEl?.querySelector('.cvid')?.remove(); }
  // THE AHA MOMENT - the scripted first rival lands as a cinematic (with a fallback toast under reduced
  // motion), then the coach + the nemesis card carry it. Jumps the player to Wet Work so the target is
  // one tap away. Deduped by a localStorage flag so a backfilled notification can't replay it.
  function showFirstBlood(p = {}) {
    if (sessionStorage.getItem('omerta_fb_seen')) return;
    sessionStorage.setItem('omerta_fb_seen', '1');
    const rival = p.rival || 'Somebody';
    sfx('bad'); haptic('big');
    playCine({ kicker: 'WORD ON THE STREET', title: `${rival} says you're nobody`, accent: 'var(--bad)',
      glow: 'rgba(155,47,47,.5)', hold: 3200,
      lines: ['They put your name in the street.', 'Find them in Wet Work - and hit back.'] });
    toast(`${rival} put word out on you - settle it in Wet Work.`, true);
    // the aha beat is a player's first taste of DANGER - a natural moment to offer alerts (after the
    // cinematic clears so the two don't collide). Once-ever + gated inside maybeAskPush.
    setTimeout(() => maybeAskPush('Someone just put your name in the street.'), 3800);
  }

  // WHICH moments earn one. Reads the SAME response body describe() reads, so this needs
  // no new server surface - it is a second, louder reading of data the client already has.
  // Returns null for everything else, which is most things, on purpose.
  const $c = (n) => '$' + fmt(n);
  function cineFor(b) {
    if (!b || typeof b !== 'object') return null;
    // �� you killed someone. The single heaviest thing a player can do.
    if (b.kill) {
      const lines = [];
      if (b.loot) lines.push(`took ${$c(b.loot)} off the body`);
      if (b.omrLoot) lines.push(`${b.omrLoot} $OMR`);
      if (b.empireLoot) lines.push(`seized their ${b.empireLoot.name}`);
      if (b.bounty) lines.push(`contract paid ${$c(b.bounty)}`);
      if (b.vendetta) lines.push('the vendetta is settled');
      return { kicker: 'wet work', title: "They're done", sub: 'the street remembers this one.',
        lines, accent: 'var(--blood)', glow: 'rgba(192,57,43,.55)', fx: 'violent' };
    }
    // �� THE AHA MOMENT - you settled your scripted first rival. The onboarding payoff beat: this is the
    // moment a new player learns the revenge loop pays. Rides the jump response (b.firstBlood).
    if (b.firstBlood) {
      return { kicker: 'first blood', title: 'You made your bones', sub: `${b.firstBlood.rival || 'they'} won't look at you sideways again.`,
        lines: [`+${$c(b.firstBlood.cash)}`, `+${b.firstBlood.rep} respect`], accent: 'var(--ok)', glow: 'rgba(99,179,113,.45)', fx: 'payday' };
    }
    // �� the Law took you. Not death, but the closest thing to it.
    if (b.convicted === true || b.busted === true) {
      return { kicker: 'the bureau', title: 'Indicted', sub: b.forfeited ? `they took ${$c(b.forfeited)}.` : 'the case landed.',
        accent: 'var(--cold)', glow: 'rgba(107,147,184,.5)', fx: 'violent', clip: 'interior-law.mp4' };
    }
    // �� over the wall
    if (b.escaped === true) {
      return { kicker: 'the pen', title: 'Over the wall', sub: "you're out - and you're WANTED.",
        accent: 'var(--neon)', fx: 'payday', clip: 'district-docks.mp4' };
    }
    // �� a genuine payday. The floor is deliberately high: a $600 crime is a toast.
    const take = Number(b.earned ?? b.payout ?? b.take ?? b.won ?? b.purse ?? b.share ?? 0);
    if (take >= 25000) {
      return { kicker: 'the score', title: $c(take), sub: 'clean, and yours.',
        lines: [], accent: 'var(--ok)', glow: 'rgba(99,179,113,.45)', fx: 'payday' };
    }
    // �� the first week, done
    if (b.capstone) return { kicker: 'made your bones', title: 'First week', sub: 'the city knows your name now.', fx: 'payday' };
    return null;
  }
  // �� DIALOGS ��������������������������������������������������������������������
  // A native alert()/prompt()/confirm() renders in the OS font on a white slab. In a game whose
  // whole surface is a 1940s ledger, that is the single loudest thing on the screen and it says
  // "browser", not "city". These three are the same three verbs in the game's own type.
  // ask() is deliberately a PROMISE so a caller can `if (!await ask(...)) return;` and read like
  // the confirm() it replaces.
  let modalSeq = 0;
  const focusableIn = (root) => [...root.querySelectorAll('button:not([disabled]), a[href], input:not([disabled]), select:not([disabled]), textarea:not([disabled]), [tabindex]:not([tabindex="-1"])')]
    .filter((node) => !node.closest('.hidden, [hidden], [inert]') && node.getClientRects().length
      && getComputedStyle(node).visibility !== 'hidden');
  function dialog(inner, { wide = false } = {}) {
    const returnFocus = document.activeElement;
    const bg = el(`<div class="modal-bg" data-managed-dialog><div class="modal" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" tabindex="-1"${wide ? ' style="max-width:640px"' : ''}>${inner}</div></div>`);
    const panel = bg.firstElementChild;
    const heading = panel.querySelector('h2');
    if (heading) {
      heading.id ||= `modal-title-${++modalSeq}`;
      panel.setAttribute('aria-labelledby', heading.id);
    } else panel.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Dialog');
    document.body.appendChild(bg);
    document.body.classList.add('modal-open');
    const onKey = (e) => {
      if (topModal() !== bg) return;
      if (e.key === 'Escape') { e.preventDefault(); bg.click(); return; }
      if (e.key !== 'Tab') return;
      const items = focusableIn(panel);
      if (!items.length) { e.preventDefault(); panel.focus(); return; }
      const first = items[0], last = items[items.length - 1];
      if (e.shiftKey && (document.activeElement === first || !items.includes(document.activeElement))) { e.preventDefault(); last.focus(); }
      else if (!e.shiftKey && (document.activeElement === last || !items.includes(document.activeElement))) { e.preventDefault(); first.focus(); }
    };
    document.addEventListener('keydown', onKey);
    let closed = false;
    const close = () => {
      if (closed) return;
      closed = true;
      document.removeEventListener('keydown', onKey);
      bg.remove();
      if (!document.querySelector('.modal-bg:not(.hidden)')) document.body.classList.remove('modal-open');
      if (returnFocus?.isConnected && !returnFocus.closest('.hidden, [hidden]')
        && (!topModal() || topModal().contains(returnFocus))) returnFocus.focus({ preventScroll: true });
    };
    bg.onclick = (e) => { if (e.target === bg) close(); };
    requestAnimationFrame(() => {
      if (!closed && topModal() === bg && !panel.contains(document.activeElement))
        (focusableIn(panel)[0] || panel).focus({ preventScroll: true });
    });
    return { bg, close };
  }
  // a read-only sheet - the leaderboards and case files that were alert()s
  function sheetModal(title, bodyHtml) {
    const { bg, close } = dialog(`<h2>${esc(title)}</h2><div class="mbody">${bodyHtml}</div>
      <div style="margin-top:14px;text-align:right"><button class="act" data-x>close</button></div>`, { wide: true });
    bg.querySelector('[data-x]').onclick = close;
  }
  // a leaderboard rendered as ranked rows rather than a \n-joined string
  const rankRows = (rows, empty) => rows?.length
    ? `<div class="ranks">${rows.map((r, i) => `<div class="rank${r.you ? ' me' : ''}">
        <b class="n">${i + 1}</b><span class="who">${esc(r.name)}</span>
        <span class="d">${esc(r.note || '')}</span><span class="v">${esc(r.val ?? '')}</span></div>`).join('')}</div>`
    : `<p class="dim">${esc(empty)}</p>`;
  // the confirm. `danger` styles it as the irreversible thing it is.
  // `alt` adds an optional THIRD choice resolving to the string 'alt' - for the one case where a
  // dialog has two real answers rather than one (sign out HERE vs sign out EVERYWHERE), because a
  // second chained dialog makes the rarer, more urgent answer the harder one to reach.
  function ask(title, body, { yes = 'do it', no = 'back off', danger = false, alt = null } = {}) {
    return new Promise((resolve) => {
      const { bg, close } = dialog(
        `<h2 style="${danger ? 'color:var(--bad)' : ''}">${esc(title)}</h2>
         <p class="dim" data-dialog-description style="white-space:pre-line">${esc(body)}</p>
         <div style="margin-top:15px;display:flex;gap:8px;justify-content:flex-end;flex-wrap:wrap">
           <button class="act" data-no>${esc(no)}</button>
           ${alt ? `<button class="act risk" data-alt>${esc(alt)}</button>` : ''}
           <button class="act ${danger ? 'risk' : 'prime'}" data-yes>${esc(yes)}</button></div>`);
      const panel = bg.querySelector('.modal');
      if (danger) panel.setAttribute('role', 'alertdialog');
      const description = bg.querySelector('[data-dialog-description]');
      description.id = `modal-description-${modalSeq}`;
      panel.setAttribute('aria-describedby', description.id);
      let done = false;
      const fin = (v) => { if (done) return; done = true; close(); resolve(v); };
      bg.querySelector('[data-yes]').onclick = () => { haptic('tap'); fin(true); };
      bg.querySelector('[data-alt]')?.addEventListener('click', () => { haptic('tap'); fin('alt'); });
      bg.querySelector('[data-no]').onclick = () => fin(false);
      bg.addEventListener('click', (e) => { if (e.target === bg) fin(false); });
    });
  }
  // the prompt. Numbers only - the one native prompt() in the file asked for a garrison amount.
  function askNum(title, label, { placeholder = '', yes = 'confirm' } = {}) {
    return new Promise((resolve) => {
      const { bg, close } = dialog(
        `<h2>${esc(title)}</h2><p class="dim">${esc(label)}</p>
         <input data-v type="number" inputmode="numeric" placeholder="${esc(placeholder)}" style="width:100%;margin-top:8px">
         <div style="margin-top:15px;display:flex;gap:8px;justify-content:flex-end">
           <button class="act" data-no>cancel</button>
           <button class="act prime" data-yes>${esc(yes)}</button></div>`);
      const inp = bg.querySelector('[data-v]');
      let done = false;
      const fin = (v) => { if (done) return; done = true; close(); resolve(v); };
      bg.querySelector('[data-yes]').onclick = () => fin(Number(inp.value) || 0);
      bg.querySelector('[data-no]').onclick = () => fin(null);
      bg.addEventListener('click', (e) => { if (e.target === bg) fin(null); });
      inp.onkeydown = (e) => { if (e.key === 'Enter') fin(Number(inp.value) || 0); };
    });
  }

  // Wrap each <h2> and everything up to the next one in a card. Purely structural - the caller's
  // template stays a flat run, so games can be added without anyone remembering to open a div.
  function feltify(root, cls = 'card felt') {
    const kids = [...root.children];
    let box = null;
    for (const node of kids) {
      if (node.tagName === 'H2') {
        box = document.createElement('div');
        box.className = cls;
        root.insertBefore(box, node);
      }
      if (box) box.appendChild(node);          // moves it out of root and into the open card
    }
  }

  // �� THE REVEAL �����������������������������������������������������������������
  // Dice, a hand, a race - the moments where the DRAW is the drama. Every handler here
  // calls renderX() straight after the result, which replaces the tab's whole innerHTML,
  // so anything drawn INTO the tab is destroyed before it can play. The reveal therefore
  // lives outside the tab, on <body>, where a re-render can't reach it.
  let revealEl = null;
  function reveal(html, hold = 1400) {
    if (REDUCED) return;                                  // off means off
    if (!revealEl) { revealEl = el('<div id="reveal"></div>'); document.body.appendChild(revealEl); }
    revealEl.innerHTML = html;
    revealEl.classList.remove('on'); void revealEl.offsetWidth; revealEl.classList.add('on');
    clearTimeout(revealEl._h);
    revealEl._h = setTimeout(() => revealEl.classList.remove('on'), hold);
  }
  // THE PASS LINE. The server sends `rolls` - the come-out roll and then every roll chasing
  // the point - and the client threw all of it away for a one-line toast. Note it sends
  // TOTALS, not two dice: rendering a pair would mean inventing which faces came up, which is
  // not something to fabricate on a gambling screen. The sequence is the real story anyway.
  function revealRoll(rolls, point, won) {
    if (REDUCED || !rolls?.length) return;
    const seq = rolls.slice(-6);                          // a long point chase truncates from the front
    reveal(`<div class="rv-dice ${won ? 'win' : 'lose'}">
      ${seq.map((r, i) => `<span class="die" style="animation-delay:${i * .1}s">${r}</span>`).join('')}
      <b>${won ? 'PASS' : point && rolls[rolls.length - 1] === 7 ? 'SEVEN OUT' : 'NO DICE'}</b></div>`,
      1200 + seq.length * 110);
  }
  const CARD_RANK = (c) => c === 1 ? 'A' : c === 11 ? 'J' : c === 12 ? 'Q' : c === 13 ? 'K' : String(c);
  // THE HOLE CARD. A finished hand comes back with the FULL `player` and `dealer` arrays, so
  // the card that sat face-down all hand can finally turn over - and every card shown is one
  // the server sent. The dealer's first card was always up; card 1 is the hole card and cards
  // 2+ are what the dealer drew chasing 17, so they flip in dealing order.
  function revealCards(b) {
    if (REDUCED || !b?.dealer?.length) return;
    const face = (c) => `<span class="pc" style="margin:0">${CARD_RANK(c)}</span>`;
    const dealt = b.dealer.map((c, i) => i === 0 ? face(c)
      : `<span class="flip"><span class="in" style="animation-delay:${(i - 1) * .26 + .15}s"
           ><span class="b">?</span><span class="f">${CARD_RANK(c)}</span></span></span>`).join('');
    const word = { blackjack: 'BLACKJACK', win: 'YOU TAKE IT', push: 'PUSH', bust: 'BUST',
      dealer_bust: 'DEALER BUSTS', loss: 'THE HOUSE TAKES IT', dealer_blackjack: "DEALER'S NATURAL" }
      [b.outcome] || String(b.outcome || '').replace(/_/g, ' ').toUpperCase();
    const cls = b.outcome === 'push' ? 'push' : Number(b.net) > 0 ? 'win' : Number(b.net) < 0 ? 'lose' : 'push';
    reveal(`<div class="rv-cards ${cls}">
      <div class="lbl">THE DEALER${b.dealerTotal != null ? ` - ${b.dealerTotal}` : ''}</div>
      <div class="hand">${dealt}</div>
      <div class="lbl">YOU${b.playerTotal != null ? ` - ${b.playerTotal}` : ''}</div>
      <div class="hand">${(b.player || []).map(face).join('')}</div>
      <b>${word}</b></div>`, 1600 + b.dealer.length * 260);
  }
  // THE LANES. A head-to-head comes back as `you {name,score}` / `them {name,score}` - boxing
  // bouts and exhibitions, stable circuits and match races all return exactly that shape - and
  // until now the client threw both scores away and printed "won". The bars ARE those numbers,
  // so a squeaker looks like a squeaker and a walkover looks like one.
  function revealLanes(b, opts = {}) {
    const a = b?.you, c = b?.them;
    if (REDUCED || !a || !c || a.score == null || c.score == null) return;
    const hi = Math.max(Number(a.score), Number(c.score)) || 1;

  // One dispatcher, keyed on shapes only these results carry - so a reveal can never fire on
  // an unrelated response, and a new head-to-head gets its lanes for free.
  function revealFor(body) {
    if (!body || REDUCED) return;
    if (body.game === 'dice' && body.rolls) return revealRoll(body.rolls, body.point, body.win);
    if (body.game === 'blackjack' && body.done) return revealCards(body);
    // The pink-slip race sends the two scores as bare NUMBERS and everything else sends
    // {name,score}; the PvE circuit calls them power/field. Same two real numbers either way.
    const sc = (v) => typeof v === 'number' ? { score: v } : v;
    let you = sc(body.you), them = sc(body.them);
    if (you?.score == null && body.power != null && body.field != null)
      { you = { name: 'your car', score: body.power }; them = { name: 'the field', score: body.field }; }
    if (you?.score == null || them?.score == null || body.win == null) return;
    const opts = body.belt ? { win: 'AND THE BELT' } : body.defended ? { win: 'TITLE DEFENDED' }
      : body.forPinks ? { win: 'PINKS - IT'S YOURS', lose: 'PINKS - IT'S GONE' } : {};
    revealLanes({ ...body, you, them }, opts);
  }

  // one place that turns a spec into sound, light and motion
  // F4 - WHAT OPENED AT THIS LEVEL. Read off the published catalogs, never a hand-written list:
  // three shapes cover everything the server publishes - an entry gated by `lvl`/`minLvl`/`minLevel`
  // (crimes, rackets, race tiers, smuggling lanes), one gated by `req.lvl` (missions), and a whole
  // SYSTEM whose block carries a scalar `minLevel` (the fights, the stable, the speakeasy). New
  // content with a level gate appears here on its own; nothing has to be remembered.
  const SYSTEM_NAMES = { boxing: 'The Fights', stable: 'The Stable', speakeasy: 'The Speakeasy',
    races: 'Street Races', port: 'The Port', duels: 'The Dueling Ladder', casino: 'The Den' };
  function unlockedAt(lvl) {
    const out = [], seen = new Set();
    const push = (label) => { if (label && !seen.has(label)) { seen.add(label); out.push(label); } };
    const walk = (o, key) => {
      if (!o || typeof o !== 'object') return;
      if (Array.isArray(o)) {
        for (const x of o) {
          if (!x || typeof x !== 'object') continue;
          const at = [x.lvl, x.minLvl, x.minLevel, x.req && x.req.lvl].find((v) => typeof v === 'number');
          if (at === lvl) push(x.name);
        }
        return;
      }
      if (typeof o.minLevel === 'number' && o.minLevel === lvl) push(SYSTEM_NAMES[key] || key);
      for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(o)) walk(v, k);
    };
    for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(rules || {})) if (k !== 'pacing') walk(v, k); // ranks live in pacing
    return out;
  }

  // �� THE STORY OF YOU AND THEM - the pair's whole recorded history in one dossier, shared by the
  // Situation's nemesis card and Wet Work's rivals board. Pure read; the server withholds the
  // detail JSONB (the info-economy rule), so this renders only kind + when + which way.
  const STORY_LINES = {
    jump: 'a jumping', shakedown: 'a shakedown', rob: 'a front robbed', car_theft: 'a car stolen',
    trunk: 'a trunk mugged', boat_theft: 'a boat stolen', sabotage: 'a stable sabotaged',
    takeover: 'a hostile takeover', kill: 'a killing', married: '?? the houses married',
    proposed: 'a marriage proposed', divorced: 'the houses split', peace_offer: '?? a sit-down offered',
    met: 'the first meeting',
  };
  async function showStory(charId, name) {
    const r = await api('GET', '/v1/people/history/' + charId);
    if (r.code >= 400) return toast(describe(r.body) || 'no story to tell', true);
    const h = r.body;
    const lines = (h.events || []).map((e) => {
      const when = e.at ? new Date(e.at).toLocaleDateString() : '';
      const who = e.who === 'me' ? 'you' : e.who === 'them' ? esc(h.them?.name || 'them') : 'the two of you';
      const what = STORY_LINES[e.kind] || e.kind;
      return `<div class="d" style="border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.05);padding:3px 0">
        <span style="color:var(--dim);font-size:11px">${when}</span> � ${e.kind === 'kill'
          ? `? <b>${who}</b> put <b>${esc(e.fell || 'somebody')}</b> in the ground`
          : `${what} - <b>${who}</b>`}</div>`;
    }).join('');
    const blood = h.bloodOwed > 0 ? `their line owes yours <b>${h.bloodOwed}</b> bod${h.bloodOwed === 1 ? 'y' : 'ies'}`
      : h.bloodOwed < 0 ? `your line owes theirs <b>${-h.bloodOwed}</b>` : 'the blood is even';
    sheetModal(`YOU & ${esc(name || h.them?.name || 'THEM')}`, `
      <div class="d" style="margin-bottom:6px">kills - yours ${h.kills?.ours ?? 0} � theirs ${h.kills?.theirs ?? 0} � ${blood}</div>
      ${lines || '<div class="d" style="color:var(--dim)">no history between your bloodlines - yet.</div>'}`);
  }
  function wireStory(scope) {
    scope.querySelectorAll('[data-story]').forEach((b) => b.onclick = () =>
      showStory(b.dataset.story, b.dataset.storyName));
  }

  async function renderStreets() {
    const t = $('#tab-streets');
    // THE BLOCK - this screen's seven boards in ONE read (see src/streets.js). Streets is where a
    // player lives, so it was the largest remaining share of what one idle player costs once Home
    // was folded. Every route below is still mounted and still answers on its own; this is a second
    // door. Bound in the `(await api(...)).body` shape ON PURPOSE (the mirror-guard idiom; a
    // `.then((r) => r.body)` slot loader passed the guard VACUOUSLY - planted mutations survived).
    const blk = (await api('GET', '/v1/block')).body || {};
    const prices = blk.prices || {};
    const spot = prices.goods?.[me?.loc] || {};
    const daily = blk.daily || {};
    const sq = blk.soldiers || {};
    const gym = blk.regimen || {};
    const hu = blk.hustle || {};
    const cn = blk.corner || {};
    // the density fix: don't wall a player with all 43 jobs - lead with the BEST ones they can
    // actually pull (the highest-level unlocked, up to 8) and fold the full book behind a drawer
    // D6a - THE APPROACH: every job takes a risk/reward choice. Case It = safer, low-heat, soft bust
    // (play it when you're hot or can't afford lockup); Go Loud = bigger single score + more contraband,
    // but draws law heat + a harder bust. Same cash EV - the choice is your risk appetite.
    const crimeApproaches = Object.fromEntries((rules?.crimeApproaches || []).map((a) => [a.id, a]));
    const quiet = crimeApproaches.quiet || {}, loud = crimeApproaches.loud || {};
    const approachTerms = `<b>QUIET</b> ${quiet.successMult ? `${Math.round((quiet.successMult - 1) * 100)}% safer, ` : ''}${quiet.heat || 0} added heat${quiet.jailMult ? `, ${Math.round((1 - quiet.jailMult) * 100)}% shorter jail` : ''}
      � <b>STANDARD</b> baseline odds and take

    { const slot = t.querySelector('#clue-slot');

      if (slot && c) {
        slot.innerHTML = c.scroll ? `<div class="card" style="border-color:var(--gold,#c9a227);margin-top:8px">

's' : ''} dug</span> <span class="d">${esc(c.legend.rank)}${c.legend.relics ? ` � ${c.legend.relics}/${c.legend.relicsMax} relics` : ''} - the next scroll turns up on a job${c.cooldownSeconds > 0 ? ' (the streets are quiet a while yet)' : ''}</span></div>` : '');

  }

  // The City board
  async function renderCity() {
    const t = $('#tab-city');
    const r = await api('GET', '/v1/city');
    if (r.code >= 400) { t.innerHTML = '<p class="d">the city is quiet.</p>'; return; }
    const c = r.body;
    // CITYWIDE - this screen's five authed boards in ONE read (see src/citywide.js). /v1/city above
    // stays its own fetch: it is keyless and already cached for everybody, which no per-player
    // aggregate can beat. Every route folded in here is still mounted and still answers on its own.
    const cw = (await api('GET', '/v1/citywide')).body || {};
    const w = cw.world || {};
    const rd = cw.raids || { raids: [] };
    const bw = cw.npcfamily || { families: [] };
    // The three Blood-War treaty/war buttons are boss-or-underboss, exactly like the frontier's
    // reinforce/invade thirty lines further down - which read the server's own `canCommand`. This
    // board doesn't publish one, so read the role off the sheet, the shape renderFamily uses ten
    // times. Stating "Boss or underboss only" in a confirm dialog is not enforcing it: the button
    // looks live to a soldier and the server answers 400 rank once he presses it.
    const cityBoss = me?.gang && (me.gang.role === 'boss' || me.gang.role === 'underboss');
    const mega = cw.mega || {};
    const shp = cw.shipment || {};
    // the trade-winds read: turn raw shock multipliers into the one actionable sentence
    const shocks = Object.entries(c.weather || {}).map(([d, x]) => [d, Number(x)]).sort((a, b) => a[1] - b[1]);
    const cheap = shocks[0], rich = shocks[shocks.length - 1];
    const spreadPct = cheap && rich ? Math.round((rich[1] / cheap[1] - 1) * 100) : 0;
    const tkb = c.tickerBallot;
    t.innerHTML = `
      ${shp.material ? `<div class="card"><span class="t" style="color:var(--neon)">?? THE SHIPMENT - ${esc(shp.material)}</span>
        <div class="d">It lands at <b>${esc(shp.districtName || shp.district || '')}</b> today. First come - the whole city shares
          ${shp.cityCap} crates a day and nobody takes more than ${shp.perPlayer}. It's the one thing money can't just buy:
          you have to be there, and you have to be early.</div>
        <div class="d" style="margin-top:4px">
          <span class="chip ${shp.cityLeft > 0 ? 'good' : 'cold'}">${shp.cityLeft} left in the city</span>
          <span class="chip">your take today: ${shp.yourTakeToday}/${shp.perPlayer}</span>
          <span class="chip">holding: ${shp.held}</span>
          ${shp.here ? '<span class="chip good">YOU\'RE STANDING IN IT</span>' : ''}</div>
        ${shp.cityLeft > 0 && shp.yourTakeLeft > 0
          ? (shp.here ? '<button class="act" data-do="POST /v1/shipment/take">take your share</button>'

        <div class="d" style="margin-top:6px;font-size:10.5px;color:var(--dim)">next few days: ${(shp.forecast || []).slice(1).map((f) => esc(f.district)).join(' � ')}</div>
        ${shp.population ? `<div class="d" style="margin-top:4px;font-size:10.5px;color:var(--dim)">The city runs ${shp.population} made men, so the docks bring in ${shp.cityCap} a day${shp.nextCapAt ? ` - ${shp.nextCapAt} on the street and it goes to ${shp.cityCap + shp.capPerStep}` : ' (as much as they ever ship)'}. More men, more crates - never more each.</div>` : ''}
        <div class="d" style="margin-top:8px"><b>The commissions</b> - what it's for. A craftsman turns it into something
          numbered and yours. Pure standing, no edge: ${shp.lootRate ? `and a killer takes ${Math.round(shp.lootRate * 100)}% of what you're carrying, so don't sit on a pile.` : ''}</div>

          // a card you can't act on has to say WHY, and in the only currency that matters here: DAYS.
          // The material can't be bought - it's ${shp.perPlayer}/day, in the right district, early - so
          // 16 units is four separate days of showing up, which is the whole term of the purchase and
          // the only way to price the "don't sit on a pile" warning directly above.

' � <b style="color:var(--bad)">yesterday\'s record DOES NOT verify</b>' : den.fair.yesterday.verified ? ` � yesterday's draw (${den.fair.yesterday.numbers}) verified against its seal �` : ` � yesterday's draw: ${den.fair.yesterday.numbers}`) : ''} - check it yourself at <span style="font-family:monospace">/v1/fairness</span></div>` : ''}
      ${den.jackpot ? `<div class="d" style="margin-top:6px;font-size:13px">?? <b>THE VIG POT</b> rides at <b style="color:var(--neon)">$${fmt(den.jackpot.pot)}</b> - an exact hit takes ${den.jackpot.winBps / 100}% of it on top of the 600:1, the rest reseeds. Every den stake feeds it (${den.jackpot.feedBps / 100}% of the action, only out of the house's own winnings).</div>` : ''}
      <h2 style="margin-top:14px">The Fight</h2>
      <div class="d" style="color:var(--dim);font-size:13.5px">${den.fight ? `<b>${den.fight.a}</b> ? favorite (pays ${den.fight.favPays}x) &nbsp;vs&nbsp; <b>${den.fight.b}</b> underdog (pays ${den.fight.dogPays}x)` : '-'}</div>
      <button class="act" id="fight-a">back ${den.fight ? den.fight.a : 'the favorite'} (fav)</button>

  function renderDeck() {
    const t = $('#tab-deck');
    t.innerHTML = `<div class="card" style="margin-top:0;border-color:var(--line2)">
      <span class="t">The Console <span class="chip">power users &amp; agents</span></span>
      <p class="d" style="color:var(--dim);font-size:13px;margin:6px 0 0">
      The raw API - <b>every</b> route the city exposes, wired to a form. This is a developer/agent tool, not
      a screen you need: the curated tabs above cover all of this with real UI, so use those first. Here you
      pick a move, <code>:params</code> become inputs, and the body is yours to edit. See also
      <code>/agents</code> and <code>/openapi.json</code>.</p></div>`;
    const groupSel = el(`<select id="deck-group">${Object.keys(DECK).map((g) => `<option>${g}</option>`).join('')}</select>`);
    const routeSel = el(`<select id="deck-route" style="max-width:min(340px,100%);min-width:0"></select>`);
    const paramBox = el(`<span id="deck-params"></span>`);
    const bodyTa = el(`<textarea id="deck-body" spellcheck="false"></textarea>`);
    const goBtn = el(`<button class="act" style="margin-top:6px">SEND</button>`);
    t.append(groupSel, ' ', routeSel, el('<div style="margin:6px 0"></div>'), paramBox, bodyTa, goBtn);
    const fillRoutes = () => {
      const routes = DECK[groupSel.value] || [];
      routeSel.innerHTML = routes.map(([m, p], i) => `<option value="${i}">${m} ${p}</option>`).join('');
      fillRoute();
    };
    const fillRoute = () => {
      const [m, p, body] = (DECK[groupSel.value] || [])[Number(routeSel.value) || 0] || [];
      paramBox.innerHTML = '';
      for (const prm of (p?.match(/:([A-Za-z]+)/g) || []))
        paramBox.appendChild(el(`<label class="f">${prm.slice(1)} <input data-prm="${prm}" size="24"></label>`));
      bodyTa.value = m === 'GET' || body === undefined ? '' : JSON.stringify(body, null, 2);
      bodyTa.style.display = m === 'GET' ? 'none' : 'block';
    };
    groupSel.onchange = fillRoutes; routeSel.onchange = fillRoute;
    goBtn.onclick = async () => {
      const [m, p] = (DECK[groupSel.value] || [])[Number(routeSel.value) || 0] || [];
      let path = p;
      for (const inp of paramBox.querySelectorAll('input')) path = path.replace(inp.dataset.prm, encodeURIComponent(inp.value.trim()));
      let body;
      if (m !== 'GET' && bodyTa.value.trim()) {
        try { body = JSON.parse(bodyTa.value); } catch { return toast('bad JSON body', true); }
      } else if (m !== 'GET') body = {};
      await act(m, path, body);
    };
    fillRoutes();
  }

            : me.gtaSeconds > 0
            ? `<button class="act risk" disabled title="the heat's still on from your last job - the boost/theft window is shared">steal their ride ?? ${minsTxt(me.gtaSeconds)}</button>`
            : `<button class="act risk" data-psteal="${s.id}" data-confirm="Boost one of their cars? A win takes the car for keeps - a miss is a stretch in lockup, and either way it burns your boost window." title="grand theft, PvP - the server picks a random car off their street; expensive iron has alarms. A miss is lockup.">steal their ride</button>`}
          ${(s.fronts || []).map((f) => noStuff
            ? `<button class="act risk"${noStuff}>rob ${f.kind}</button>`
            : `<button class="act risk" data-prob="${f.id}" data-confirm="Hit the register at their ${f.kind}? A win skims the take - a miss is a short stretch in lockup." title="rob their ${f.kind} - a cut of its uncollected take; stealth (cunning + speed). A miss is lockup.">rob ${f.kind}</button>`).join('')}
          <button class="act risk" data-ptrunk="${s.id}"${noBody || ' title="mug the freight off their back - one crate of trade goods, capped by your own trunk space; stealth. A miss is lockup."'}>rob trunk</button>
          ${noStuff
            ? `<button class="act risk"${noStuff}>steal boat</button>`
            : me.gtaSeconds > 0
            ? `<button class="act risk" disabled title="the heat's still on - the boost/theft window is shared">steal boat ?? ${minsTxt(me.gtaSeconds)}</button>`
            : me.loc !== 'docks'
            ? `<button class="act risk" disabled title="boats are stolen where they float - travel to the docks first">steal boat ? docks only</button>`
            : `<button class="act risk" data-pboat="${s.id}" data-confirm="Steal a boat off their berth? A win takes the boat, a miss is a stretch in lockup, and it burns your boost window." title="boat theft at the docks - the server picks a docked boat; a big hull has watchmen. A miss is lockup.">steal boat</button>`}
          <button class="act risk" data-psab="${s.id}"${noStuff || ' title="wreck their stable - one random racer or fighter laid up for hours; stealth. A miss is lockup."'}>sabotage</button>
          <select data-npctier="${s.id}" style="font-size:11px"${noBody}>${npcs.map(([id, n]) => `<option value="${id}">${n}</option>`).join('')}</select>
          <button class="act risk" data-npchit="${s.id}"${noBody}>NPC hit</button>
          ${s.guardPrice != null ? `<button class="act" data-hire="${s.id}"${noBody || ''} title="$${fmt(s.guardPrice)} up front - he absorbs ONE lethal shot for you and the contract is spent (he goes to hospital in your place). The window comes back on the receipt.">hire guard</button>` : ''}
          <button class="act" data-feud="${s.id}">feud</button></div>`; }).join('')}</div>`;

    t.querySelectorAll('[data-psteal]').forEach((b) => b.onclick = () =>
      act('POST', `/v1/streets/${b.dataset.psteal}/steal`, {}).then(() => renderPvp()));
    t.querySelectorAll('[data-prob]').forEach((b) => b.onclick = () =>
      act('POST', `/v1/business/${b.dataset.prob}/rob`, {}).then(() => renderPvp()));
    t.querySelectorAll('[data-ptrunk]').forEach((b) => b.onclick = () =>
      act('POST', `/v1/streets/${b.dataset.ptrunk}/trunk`, {}).then(() => renderPvp()));
    t.querySelectorAll('[data-pboat]').forEach((b) => b.onclick = () =>
      act('POST', `/v1/streets/${b.dataset.pboat}/boat`, {}).then(() => renderPvp()));
    t.querySelectorAll('[data-psab]').forEach((b) => b.onclick = () =>
      act('POST', `/v1/streets/${b.dataset.psab}/sabotage`, {}).then(() => renderPvp()));
    t.querySelectorAll('[data-pullstake]').forEach((b) => b.onclick = () => {
      const [tid, kind] = b.dataset.pullstake.split(':');
      act('POST', `/v1/contracts/${tid}/${kind}/cancel`, {}).then(() => renderPvp());
    });
    t.querySelector('#ct-post').onclick = () => {
      const body = { amount: Number(t.querySelector('#ct-amt').value), kind: t.querySelector('#ct-kind').value };
      if (t.querySelector('#ct-anon').checked) body.anon = true;
      const rsn = t.querySelector('#ct-reason').value.trim(); if (rsn) body.reason = rsn;
      const hm = t.querySelector('#ct-hitman').value; if (hm) { body.hitman = hm;
        const ex = Number(t.querySelector('#ct-excl').value); if (ex) body.exclusiveHours = ex; }
      act('POST', `/v1/streets/${t.querySelector('#ct-target').value}/bounty`, body).then(() => renderPvp());
    };
    { const fp = t.querySelector('#fc-post');
      if (fp) fp.onclick = () => {
        const amount = Number(t.querySelector('#fc-amt').value);
        if (!(amount > 0)) { toast('name a pot for the family to fund', true); return; }
        act('POST', `/v1/gangs/contract/${t.querySelector('#fc-target').value}`,
          { amount, kind: t.querySelector('#fc-kind').value }).then(() => renderPvp());
      }; }
    { const ss = t.querySelector('#du-setstyle');
      if (ss) ss.onclick = () => act('POST', '/v1/duels/style', { style: t.querySelector('#du-style').value }).then(() => renderPvp());
      const dl = t.querySelector('#du-list');
      if (dl) dl.onclick = () => act('POST', '/v1/duels/list', { limit: Number(t.querySelector('#du-limit').value) }).then(() => renderPvp());
      const du = t.querySelector('#du-unlist');
      if (du) du.onclick = () => act('POST', '/v1/duels/list', { limit: null }).then(() => renderPvp());
      t.querySelectorAll('[data-duel]').forEach((b) => b.onclick = () =>
        act('POST', `/v1/duels/${b.dataset.duel}`, { amount: Number(t.querySelector(`[data-duamt="${b.dataset.duel}"]`).value) }).then(() => renderPvp())); }
    t.querySelectorAll('[data-dm]').forEach((b) => b.onclick = () => {
      $('#phone').classList.remove('hidden'); openPhoneThread(b.dataset.dm);
    });
    t.querySelectorAll('[data-nodm]').forEach((b) => b.onclick = () =>
      toast("no number - meet them face to face (a jump counts), or put a wire on them", true));
    t.querySelectorAll('[data-jump]').forEach((b) => b.onclick = () =>
      act('POST', `/v1/streets/${b.dataset.jump}/jump`, { intent: b.dataset.intent || 'standard' }).then(() => renderPvp()));
    wireStory(t); // the rivals board's "the story" dossiers
    // the 7.8 bust - until now this verb lived ONLY in the raw deck, so the daily "bust a player
    // out of lockup" contract pointed at a control that did not exist
    t.querySelectorAll('[data-pbust]').forEach((b) => b.onclick = () =>
      act('POST', `/v1/streets/${b.dataset.pbust}/bust`, {}).then(() => renderPvp()));
    t.querySelectorAll('[data-search]').forEach((b) => b.onclick = async () => {
      const r = await act('POST', `/v1/streets/${b.dataset.search}/search`, {});
      if (r.code < 400 && r.body.placedAt)
        localStorage.setItem(huntKey(), JSON.stringify({ targetId: b.dataset.search, name: b.dataset.name, placedAt: r.body.placedAt }));
      renderPvp();
    });
    t.querySelectorAll('[data-npchit]').forEach((b) => b.onclick = async () => {
      if (!await ask('Put a man on them?', 'The fee burns whether the hit lands or not, and it draws law heat on YOU. A hired gun pays no reputation.',
        { yes: 'make the call', no: 'forget it', danger: true })) return;
      act('POST', `/v1/streets/${b.dataset.npchit}/npchit`, { tier: t.querySelector(`[data-npctier="${b.dataset.npchit}"]`).value }).then(() => renderPvp()); });
    t.querySelectorAll('[data-hire]').forEach((b) => b.onclick = () =>
      act('POST', `/v1/bodyguard/hire/${b.dataset.hire}`, {}).then(() => renderPvp()));
    t.querySelectorAll('[data-feud]').forEach((b) => b.onclick = async () => {
      const f = (await api('GET', `/v1/feud/${b.dataset.feud}`)).body || {};
      // THE BLOOD LEDGER - the running body count between two bloodlines. It used to be a
      // \n-joined confirm(); as a card the tally reads at a glance and the two vendettas can
      // actually carry their own colour, which is the whole point of a feud screen.
      const days = (s) => Math.ceil((s || 0) / 86400);
      const body = `<div class="row" style="font-size:16px;margin:2px 0 12px">
          <span><b style="color:var(--ok)">${f.kills?.theirs || 0}</b> <span class="k">you took</span></span>
          <span><span class="k">they took</span> <b style="color:var(--bad)">${f.kills?.ours || 0}</b></span></div>`
        + (f.myVendetta ? `<div class="card" style="border-color:var(--blood)"><span class="t">? YOUR VENDETTA - ${esc(f.myVendetta.tier)}</span>
            <div class="d">sworn for ${esc(f.myVendetta.sworn)} � ${days(f.myVendetta.expiresSeconds)}d left to settle it</div></div>` : '')
        + (f.theirVendetta ? `<div class="card" style="border-color:var(--bad);margin-top:8px"><span class="t">?? THEY'VE SWORN ONE ON YOU - ${esc(f.theirVendetta.tier)}</span>
            <div class="d">their line is hunting yours.</div></div>` : '')
        + (!f.myVendetta && !f.theirVendetta ? '<p class="dim">No live vendetta between your lines - just the tally.</p>' : '');
      // THE SIT-DOWN: accept a standing offer, else offer peace if there's a live feud
      // one card, two possible verbs - the ledger is always shown, the button changes with the state.
      // The act() call stays at the CALL SITE with a literal path: test/client.js reads these
      // statically to prove every route the client can issue is really mounted, and a path threaded
      // through a variable is exactly the shape it cannot read (it counted this and failed the run).
      const feudCard = (extra, yesLabel, go) => {
        const { bg, close } = dialog(`<h2>Blood feud with ${esc(f.bloodline)}</h2>${body}${extra}
          <div style="margin-top:15px;display:flex;gap:8px;justify-content:flex-end">
            <button class="act" data-no>let the blood stand</button>
            <button class="act prime" data-yes>${esc(yesLabel)}</button></div>`);
        bg.querySelector('[data-no]').onclick = close;
        bg.querySelector('[data-yes]').onclick = async () => { close(); await go(); };
      };
      if (f.peace?.theyOffered) {
        feudCard('<p class="dim" style="margin-top:10px">?? They have offered a sit-down. Accept and both lines are wiped clean.</p>',
          'take the sit-down', () => act('POST', `/v1/feud/${b.dataset.feud}/peace/accept`, {}));
        return;
      }
      if ((f.myVendetta || f.theirVendetta) && !f.peace?.iOffered) {
        feudCard('', 'sue for peace', () => act('POST', `/v1/feud/${b.dataset.feud}/peace`, {}));
        return;
      }
      sheetModal(`Blood feud with ${f.bloodline}`, body + (f.peace?.iOffered ? '<p class="dim">?? your peace offer stands - waiting on them.</p>' : ''));
    });
    t.querySelectorAll('[data-fire]').forEach((b) => b.onclick = async () => {
      // A kill ends someone's street for good and swears their bloodline against yours for a week.
      // Every other irreversible act in the game asks first; this one - the heaviest - did not.
      if (!await ask('Take the shot?', `${b.dataset.name || 'This man'} does not get back up. Their heir will swear a vendetta on your line, and the street will know it was you.`,
        { yes: 'take the shot', no: 'let him walk', danger: true })) return;
      // HOW MANY ROUNDS. Found by playing, and it made the whole verb inert: the server takes a
      // `rounds` count and floors it at the 7.7 minimum of 50, and this button sent NONE - so
      // every shot the console has ever fired was exactly 50 rounds. The best iron in the game
      // turns 50 into 95 effective, against a floor of ~390 for a LEVEL-1 mark, so the button
      // could not kill anybody, at any level, with any gun, ever - after a 3h search, the energy,
      // the ammo and a 2h trigger cooldown. It is the player's decision (the API always said so),
      // and the miss line now teaches the number: "40 rounds told and he can take 13,030" is what
      // you spend the next magazine on. Default what the game itself calls a magazine, capped by
      // what's in the drawer, so pressing enter is a real shot rather than a wasted contract.
      // And the TERMS ride with the number, because the server spends every round you name whether
      // it needed them or not (`ch.ammo -= fired`). "How many rounds?" reads like a ceiling and is
      // a bill - the same silence that put the pad and the nut in front of a tester. Say which way
      // the mistake cuts, too: over-spending costs $40 a round, under-spending costs the contract.
      const held = Number(me.ammo || 0);
      const rounds = await askNum('How many rounds?',
        `You hold ${fmt(held)}. Every round you call for is SPENT - hit or miss, needed or not - at $40 a round to replace. `
        + `Under-spend and he walks, and your search burns with him. Spend over and you have only bought brass. The floor is 50.`,
        { placeholder: String(Math.max(50, Math.min(held, 2000))), yes: 'open up' });
      if (rounds === null) return;
      const r = await act('POST', `/v1/streets/${b.dataset.fire}/fire`, { rounds: rounds || Math.max(50, Math.min(held, 2000)) });
      // the server consumes the search on every resolved shot (kill or miss) - clear the local
      // hunt on any 2xx, and on a stale no_search too
      if (r.code < 400 || r.body?.error === 'no_search') localStorage.removeItem(huntKey());
      renderPvp();
    });
    const off = t.querySelector('#hunt-off');
    if (off) off.onclick = () => act('DELETE', '/v1/streets/search').then(() => { localStorage.removeItem(huntKey()); renderPvp(); });
    t.querySelector('#bg-offer').onclick = () =>
      act('POST', '/v1/bodyguard/offer', { price: Number(t.querySelector('#bg-price').value) }).then(() => renderPvp());
  }

  // �� THE LAW: the investigation meter, the escapes, the courtroom, the informant's door ��
  async function renderLaw() {
    const t = $('#tab-law');
    await refresh();
    const r = await api('GET', '/v1/law');
    if (r.code >= 400) { t.innerHTML = '<span class="d">the docket is sealed.</span>'; return; }
    const L = r.body;
    const meterMax = Math.max(L.thresholds.indict * 1.2, L.exposure);
    const mark = (v) => `${Math.min(100, 100 * v / meterMax)}%`;
    const stageColor = { clean: 'var(--ok)', watched: 'var(--neon)', investigation: 'var(--neon)', indicted: 'var(--bad)' }[L.stage] || 'var(--dim)';
    t.innerHTML = `
      <h2>The Rap Sheet</h2>
      <div class="card"><span class="t" style="color:${stageColor};text-transform:uppercase">${L.stage}</span>
        ${L.rat ? '<span class="chip bad">RAT - the badge follows the bloodline</span>' : ''}
        ${L.patrol ? '<span class="chip cold">PATROL HOURS - the Bureau convicts harder</span>' : ''}
        <div class="d" style="margin-top:6px">the case: ${L.exposure} exposure � heat above ${L.watch} feeds it (yours: ${me.heat}) � today x${L.cityEvent.exposureMult} (${esc(L.cityEvent.name)})</div>
        <!-- the RICO meter used to be byte-identical to the energy bar. It now carries the three
             thresholds as MARKS ON the track rather than text below it, so "how close am I to
             losing everything" is answerable at a glance instead of by arithmetic. -->
        <div class="bar ricobar" style="height:18px;position:relative;margin-top:7px">
          <i style="width:${mark(L.exposure)};background:${stageColor}"></i>
          <b class="tick" style="left:${mark(L.thresholds.watched)}"></b>
          <b class="tick" style="left:${mark(L.thresholds.investigation)}"></b>
          <b class="tick bad" style="left:${mark(L.thresholds.indict)}"></b></div>
        <div class="d" style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;font-size:11px">
          <span>watched @ ${L.thresholds.watched}</span><span>investigation @ ${L.thresholds.investigation}</span><span style="color:var(--bad)">INDICTMENT @ ${L.thresholds.indict}</span></div></div>

      ${L.indicted ? `
      <h2 style="margin-top:12px" >The Case Against You</h2>
      <div class="card" style="border-color:var(--blood)">
        <span class="t" style="color:var(--bad)">UNDER INDICTMENT</span>
        <!-- the two numbers that decide your fate were inside a 12.5px dim paragraph -->
        <div class="row" style="font-size:19px;margin:6px 0 2px">
          <span style="color:var(--bad)">~${L.convictionOdds}% <span class="k" style="font-size:12px">CONVICTION</span></span>
          <span class="live">${mins(L.graceSeconds)} <span class="k" style="font-size:12px">TO TRIAL</span></span></div>
        <div class="d">a conviction seizes ${Math.round(L.forfeitRate * 100)}% of pocket + bank (staked $OMR + minted gear are SAFE) and jails you - the street SURVIVES</div>
        <div style="margin-top:8px">
          <button class="act" data-do="POST /v1/law/plea"
            data-confirm="Cop a plea?|You hand them ${Math.round((L.plea?.forfeitRate || 0) * 100)}% of pocket and bank and do ${mins(L.plea?.jailSeconds || 0)} inside - certain, no roll. The case is closed." data-confirm-yes="take the deal">cop a plea (${Math.round((L.plea?.forfeitRate || 0) * 100)}% + ${mins(L.plea?.jailSeconds || 0)} inside)</button>
          <button class="act" data-do="POST /v1/law/jury" ${L.jury.bought ? 'disabled' : ''}>${L.jury.bought ? 'jury bought' : `buy the jury (${L.jury.cost} $OMR)`}</button>
          <button class="act risk" data-do="POST /v1/law/trial"
            data-confirm="Demand trial now?|You give up the clock and roll it here: ~${L.convictionOdds}% they convict. A conviction takes ${Math.round(L.forfeitRate * 100)}% of your pocket AND your bank." data-confirm-yes="face the jury">demand trial NOW</button>
        </div></div>` : ''}

      <h2 style="margin-top:12px">The Escapes</h2>
      <div class="grid">
        <div class="card"><span class="t">Grease the Beat Cop</span>
          <div class="d">${L.bribeCost != null ? `$${fmt(L.bribeCost)} knocks ${L.bribeClears} off the meter (wealth-scaled)` : 'a FILED case is past bribing'}</div>
          ${L.bribeCost != null ? '<button class="act" data-do="POST /v1/law/bribe">pay</button>' : ''}</div>
        <div class="card"><span class="t">The Lawyer</span>
          <div class="d">${L.retainer.active ? `on retainer - ${mins(L.retainer.seconds)} left (softer busts, smaller forfeits)` : `$${fmt(L.retainer.cost)} keeps counsel on call`}</div>
          ${L.retainer.active ? '' : '<button class="act" data-do="POST /v1/law/retainer">retain</button>'}</div>
        <div class="card"><span class="t">The Envelope</span>
          <div class="d">${L.envelope.active ? `current - ${mins(L.envelope.seconds)} left. The cops bury your file: the case builds at ${Math.round(L.envelope.gainMult * 100)}% rate AND cools ${L.envelope.bleedMult}x faster.` : `slip the precinct ${L.envelope.cost} $OMR - while it's current the case builds slower (${Math.round(L.envelope.gainMult * 100)}%) and cools ${L.envelope.bleedMult}x faster. Standing protection, not a one-shot.`}</div>
          <button class="act" data-do="POST /v1/law/envelope">${L.envelope.active ? 'top up the envelope' : `pay ${L.envelope.cost} $OMR`}</button></div>
        <div class="card"><span class="t">Lay Low / Clean Papers</span>
          <div class="d">heat feeds the case - cool it in the Kitchen tab</div></div>
      </div>

      <h2 style="margin-top:12px">The Informant's Door</h2>
      <div class="card">
        <div class="d">FLIP: drop your case by naming a rival - seeds their meter, brands you a RAT forever
        (omert� void on your head; witness protection opens). The named man collapsing YOUR case means
        someone probably wants you dead.</div>
        <select id="flip-target"></select>
        <button class="act" id="flip-go" style="border-color:var(--blood)">flip on them</button>
        ${L.witpro.available ? '<button class="act" data-do="POST /v1/law/witpro">enter witness protection</button>' : ''}
        ${L.witpro.active ? `<span class="chip cold">WITPRO - untargetable ${mins(L.witpro.seconds)}</span>` : ''}
      </div>`;
    const streets = ((await api('GET', '/v1/streets')).body?.streets || []).filter((s) => s.id !== me.id);
    $('#flip-target').innerHTML = streets.map((s) => `<option value="${s.id}">${esc(s.name)} (lvl ${s.level})</option>`).join('');
    $('#flip-go').onclick = async () => {
      if (!await ask('Give them a name?', 'Your case goes away and theirs begins. You are branded a RAT for good - omert� no longer protects you, and your own family can hunt you. It follows your bloodline.',
        { yes: 'name him', no: 'keep your mouth shut', danger: true })) return;
      act('POST', `/v1/law/flip/${$('#flip-target').value}`, {}).then(() => renderLaw()); };
  }

  // �� THE WIRE: the intelligence terminal - wiretaps on rivals + the Street Wire premium feed ��
  async function renderWire() {
    const t = $('#tab-wire');
    await refresh();
    const r = await api('GET', '/v1/wire');
    if (r.code >= 400) { t.innerHTML = '<span class="d">the line is dead.</span>'; return; }
    const W = r.body;
    const SEC = (await api('GET', '/v1/secrets')).body || {};
    const bandColor = (s) => ({ 'red hot': 'var(--bad)', hot: 'var(--blood)', warm: 'var(--neon)', cold: 'var(--dim)' })[s] || 'var(--dim)';
    const stageColor = { clean: 'var(--ok)', watched: 'var(--neon)', investigation: 'var(--neon)', indicted: 'var(--bad)' };
    // (D11 2026-08-05: the ticker tape retired with the Portfolio)
    // your live wires - the intel on each tapped mark
    const wires = (W.taps || []).map((i) => `
      <div class="card">
        <span class="t">${esc(i.name)} <span class="dim">lvl ${i.level}</span></span>
        ${i.huntingYou ? '<span class="chip bad">HUNTING YOU</span>' : ''}${i.wanted ? '<span class="chip bad">WANTED</span>' : ''}
        <div class="d" style="margin-top:4px">
          the law: <b style="color:${stageColor[i.law.stage] || 'var(--dim)'};text-transform:uppercase">${i.law.stage}</b>${i.law.indicted ? ' � INDICTED' : ''} � heat <b style="color:${bandColor(i.law.heat)}">${i.law.heat}</b><br>
          money: ${i.wealth}<br>
          rackets: ${i.ops.businesses} front(s) � ${i.ops.rackets} racket(s) � ${i.ops.territory} turf op(s)${i.ops.family ? ' � <b>' + i.ops.family + '</b>' : ' � unaffiliated'}
        </div>
        <div class="d" style="font-size:11px;margin-top:4px">wire runs ${mins(i.expiresSeconds)}</div>
      </div>`).join('');
    // your standing informants - the TRUE read (pierces a mark's disinformation) + who they're hunting
    const informants = (W.informants || []).map((i) => `
      <div class="card" style="border-color:var(--neon)">
        <span class="t">${esc(i.name)} <span class="dim">lvl ${i.level}</span></span> <span class="chip good">INFORMANT</span>
        ${i.huntingYou ? '<span class="chip bad">HUNTING YOU</span>' : ''}${i.wanted ? '<span class="chip bad">WANTED</span>' : ''}
        <div class="d" style="margin-top:4px">
          the law: <b style="color:${stageColor[i.law.stage] || 'var(--dim)'};text-transform:uppercase">${i.law.stage}</b> � heat <b style="color:${bandColor(i.law.heat)}">${i.law.heat}</b> � money: ${i.wealth}<br>
          rackets: ${i.ops.businesses} front(s) � ${i.ops.rackets} racket(s) � ${i.ops.territory} turf op(s)${i.ops.family ? ' � <b>' + i.ops.family + '</b>' : ''}<br>
          hunting ${i.huntingAnyone} mark(s) right now
        </div>
        <div class="d" style="font-size:11px;margin-top:4px">retainer runs ${mins(i.paidSeconds)} � a human source can't be fed lies</div>
      </div>`).join('');
    // SOMEONE IS SQUEEZING YOU - this was the TENTH section, buried under a subscribe
    // card. It is a countdown with your money on it; it leads.
    const squeeze = (SEC.onMe || []).length ? `<div class="grid" style="margin-bottom:12px">${SEC.onMe.map((s) => `
        <div class="card threat" style="border-color:var(--bad)"><span class="t" style="color:var(--bad)">\u26a0 THEY HAVE ${esc(s.kindName.toUpperCase())}</span>

        + fileRow('the law', `${esc(d.law.stage.toUpperCase())}${d.law.indicted ? ' � INDICTED' : ''}`, d.law.indicted ? 'bad' : '')
        + fileRow('street heat', d.law.heat)
        + fileRow('money', esc(d.wealth))
        + fileRow('record', `${d.record.kills} kill(s) � ${d.record.deaths} death(s)`)
        + fileRow('wires out on', d.watching.length ? esc(d.watching.join(', ')) : 'nobody')
        + `<p class="dim" style="margin-top:12px;font-size:12px">Money is a band, never a figure - the file doesn't carry an exact number.</p>`);
      renderWire();
    };
    const wlb = $('#wire-lb'); if (wlb) wlb.onclick = async (e) => { e.preventDefault();
      const d = (await api('GET', '/v1/leaderboard/wire')).body || {};
      sheetModal('THE SPYMASTER - busiest intel operators',
        rankRows((d.spies || []).map((x) => ({ name: x.name, note: x.rank, val: `${fmt(x.ops)} ops` })),
          'nobody\'s been listening yet')); };
  }

  }

  // �� THE EMPIRE: personal fronts - income, the pad, PvP risk + the Bureau (heat from earning) ��
