    const cat = (await api('GET', '/v1/catalog')).body?.businesses || [];
    const ownedKinds = new Set(owned.map((b) => b.kind));
    const emp = rules?.empire || {};
    // THE HERO BAND - the two numbers that matter on this screen: what the empire earns, and what's
    // sitting uncollected right now (the call-to-action). Derived from the fronts already in hand.
    const totalHr = owned.reduce((a, b) => a + (Number(b.incomePerHr) || 0), 0);
    const totalPending = owned.reduce((a, b) => a + (Number(b.pending) || 0), 0);
    const empHero = owned.length ? heroBand([
      { v: '$' + fmt(totalHr), label: 'earning / hr', cls: 'neon' },
      // A call to action must be answerable: while you're to ground the take is frozen, so the sub
      // says when it thaws instead of urging a button the server will refuse.
      { v: '$' + fmt(totalPending), label: 'ready to collect', cls: totalPending > 0 ? 'warn' : '',
        sub: totalPending <= 0 ? 'all collected'
          : toGround() ? `frozen while you're to ground - ${minsTxt(me.safeSeconds)}` : 'collect before the pad or a raid eats it' },
      { v: String(owned.length), label: 'fronts' },
    ]) : '';
    t.innerHTML = `
      ${empHero}
      ${!owned.length ? coachCard('Legit fronts - passive income', 'Buy a business (level-gated - the catalog is below) and it earns pocket cash on its own while you are away.         <button class="act" data-do="POST /v1/business/upkeep">pay the pad${(() => { const o = owned.reduce((a, b) => a + (Number(b.upkeepOwed) || 0), 0); return o > 0 ? ` - $${fmt(o)} owed` : ''; })()}</button></h2>

        // elapsed minutes, and the server's own upgrade response returns `x 60` as `incomePerHr` -
        // but this card has rendered the raw figure labelled "/hr" since it shipped. A laundromat
        // showed "$30/hr" while paying $1,800/hr, on the screen a player uses to decide what to buy.
        const perHr = (x) => Math.floor(Number(x || 0) * 60);
        const effIncome = owned ? (me.racketIncomePerHr?.[r.id] ?? perHr(r.income)) : perHr(r.income);
        return `<div class="card"><span class="t">${esc(r.name)}</span>${owned ? `<span class="chip good">owned${lvl ? ` � lvl ${lvl}` : ''}</span>` : locked ? `<span class="chip">lvl ${r.lvl}+</span>` : ''}
          <div class="d">$${fmt(effIncome)}/hr${owned && lvl ? ` <span style="color:var(--dim)">(base $${fmt(perHr(r.income))})</span>` : ''} � $${fmt(r.cost)} � ${esc(r.desc)}</div>
          ${owned ? `${lvl < upMax ? `<button class="act" data-rkup="${r.id}">muscle it up  lvl ${lvl + 1}</button>` : '<span class="chip">maxed</span>'}
              <button class="act" data-rkout="${r.id}:${esc(r.name)}" style="border-color:var(--warn);color:var(--warn)">retire</button>`
            : locked ? '' : `<button class="act" data-rkbuy="${r.id}"${noSeat ? ' disabled' : ''}>${noSeat ? '?? no free seat' : 'buy'}</button>`}</div>`; }).join('')}</div>

      <h2 style="margin-top:14px">Assets <span class="d" style="font-size:11px">- wheels (cargo/speed), property (energy cap) & legit fronts (income)</span></h2>
      <div class="grid">${(rules?.assets || []).map((a) => { const owned = (me.assets || []).includes(a.id);
        // Only the metered category takes a seat - so only those buttons can be gated by one.
        const seats = a.cat === (rules?.operations?.meteredCat || ''), noSeat = seats && !owned && (me.ops?.free || 0) <= 0;
        return `<div class="card"><span class="t">${esc(a.name)}</span>${owned ? '<span class="chip good">owned</span>' : `<span class="chip">${a.cat}</span>`}${seats ? '<span class="chip">takes a seat</span>' : ''}
          <div class="d">$${fmt(a.price)}${a.boost ? ` � +${a.boost} ${a.stat}` : ''}${a.cargo ? ` � +${a.cargo} cargo` : ''} � ${esc(a.desc)}</div>
          ${owned ? '' : `<button class="act" data-asbuy="${a.id}"${noSeat ? ' disabled' : ''}>${noSeat ? '?? no free seat' : 'buy'}</button>`}</div>`; }).join('')}</div>`;
    t.querySelectorAll('[data-bizbuy]').forEach((b) => b.onclick = () =>
      act('POST', `/v1/business/${b.dataset.bizbuy}/buy`, {}).then(() => renderEmpire()));
    t.querySelectorAll('[data-bizup]').forEach((b) => b.onclick = () =>
      act('POST', `/v1/business/${b.dataset.bizup}/upgrade`, {}).then(() => renderEmpire()));
    t.querySelectorAll('[data-bizspec]').forEach((b) => b.onclick = () => { const [id, spec] = b.dataset.bizspec.split(':');
      act('POST', `/v1/business/${id}/specialize`, { spec }).then(() => renderEmpire()); });
    // WALK AWAY. Irreversible and it frees the UNIQUE(character, kind) slot, so it gets the same
    // confirm the other one-way doors get (FIRE, the shank, the loan collect).
    t.querySelectorAll('[data-bizshut]').forEach((b) => b.onclick = async () => {
      const [id, name, back] = b.dataset.bizshut.split(':');
      const ok = await ask(`Close up ${art(name)}?`, `It's gone for good - the tier, the specialization and every dollar sunk in.
        You get $${fmt(Number(back) || 0)} back${Number(back) ? '' : ' - nothing'}, and the pad on it stops. You'd be free to buy that
        kind of front again later, at t1 prices.`, { yes: 'close it up', no: 'keep it', danger: true });
      if (ok) act('DELETE', `/v1/business/${id}`, {}).then(() => renderEmpire());
    });
    { const g = $('#biz-takeover-go'); if (g) g.onclick = () => act('POST', `/v1/business/${$('#biz-takeover-id').value.trim()}/takeover`, {}).then(() => renderEmpire()); }
    { const lb = t.querySelector('#launderer-board'); if (lb) lb.onclick = async (e) => { e.preventDefault();
      const b = (await api('GET', '/v1/leaderboard/launderers')).body?.launderers || [];
      t.querySelector('#launderer-lb').innerHTML = `<div style="margin-top:6px">${b.slice(0, 10).map((x) => `<div class="d">#${x.rank} ${esc(x.name)}${x.tag ? ` [${esc(x.tag)}]` : ''} - ${esc(x.title)} ($${fmt(x.washed)})</div>`).join('') || '<div class="d">none yet</div>'}</div>`; }; }
    t.querySelectorAll('[data-rkbuy]').forEach((b) => b.onclick = () => act('POST', `/v1/rackets/${b.dataset.rkbuy}/buy`, {}).then(() => renderEmpire()));
    t.querySelectorAll('[data-rkup]').forEach((b) => b.onclick = () => act('POST', `/v1/rackets/${b.dataset.rkup}/upgrade`, {}).then(() => renderEmpire()));
    // RETIRE - irreversible, frees the seat, returns nothing. Same confirm the other one-way doors get.
    t.querySelectorAll('[data-rkout]').forEach((b) => b.onclick = async () => {
      const [id, name] = b.dataset.rkout.split(':');
      const back = Math.floor((rules?.rackets || []).find((r) => r.id === id)?.cost * ((rules?.operations?.retireBps || 0) / 10000)) || 0;
      const ok = await ask(`Walk away from ${art(name)}?`, `The seat frees up and you can take on something else.
        You get $${fmt(back)} back${back ? '' : ' - nothing'}, and every level you muscled into it goes with it.`,
        { yes: 'walk away', no: 'keep it', danger: true });
      if (ok) act('DELETE', `/v1/rackets/${id}`, {}).then(() => renderEmpire());
    });
    t.querySelectorAll('[data-asbuy]').forEach((b) => b.onclick = () => act('POST', `/v1/assets/${b.dataset.asbuy}/buy`, {}).then(() => renderEmpire()));
    const tb = t.querySelector('#tycoon-board');
    if (tb) tb.onclick = async (e) => { e.preventDefault();
      const r = (await api('GET', '/v1/leaderboard/tycoons')).body?.tycoons || [];
      t.querySelector('#tycoon-lb').innerHTML = `<div class="grid" style="margin-top:4px">${r.map((k) => `<div class="card"><span class="t">#${k.pos} ${esc(k.name)}</span><div class="d">${k.rank} � $${fmt(k.earned)} earned</div></div>`).join('') || '<span class="d">no earners ranked yet</span>'}</div>`; };
  }

  // �� THE SPEAKEASY: the social hub - your club, the nightlife map, buying rounds where you stand ��
  async function renderSpeakeasy() {
    const t = $('#tab-speakeasy');
    await refresh();
    const b = (await api('GET', '/v1/speakeasy')).body || {};
    const sp = rules?.speakeasy || {};
    const distName = (id) => (rules?.districts || []).find((d) => d.id === id)?.name || id;
    const mine = me.speakeasy;
    const here = (b.clubs || []).find((c) => c.district === me.loc);        // the club where you're standing
    const canOpenHere = !mine && b.open?.includes(me.loc);
    const styles = sp.decorStyles || {};                                    // { id: displayName }

    const ownedDecor = store.owned?.cosmetics || [];

    t.innerHTML = `
      ${!mine && !(b.clubs || []).length ? coachCard('Open a club - be the man to see', 'A speakeasy is the district\'s premier nightclub: it farms cash on its own AND is where the city gathers to be seen. One per district, level ' + (sp.minLevel || 15) + '+. Patrons buy rounds (you pocket the cut) and bottle service; the busiest room tops the nightlife. It dies with your street, so it\'s a marked man\'s prize.') : ''}
      <div class="card" style="border-color:var(--gold)"><span class="t">Your renown: ${rn.rank} <span class="chip">${fmt(rn.renown)}</span></span>
        <div class="d">The nightlife legend - earned by being seen (rounds + bottles) and running a room. <a href="#" id="sp-nl">the leaderboard </a></div></div>
      <h2>You're at: ${esc(distName(me.loc))}</h2>
      ${mine ? `
      <div class="card" style="border-color:var(--neon)">${aart('club', mine.tier)}<span class="t">${esc(mine.name || mine.tierName)} <span class="chip good">YOUR HOUSE</span></span>
        ${mine.shutSeconds ? `<span class="chip bad">RAIDED - dark ${mins(mine.shutSeconds)}</span>` : mine.raidRisk ? '<span class="chip bad">HOT - the Prohibition boys are watching</span>' : ''}
        <div class="d">${esc(distName(mine.district))} � ${esc(mine.tierName)} � prestige ${mine.prestige} � $${fmt(mine.incomePerHr)}/hr � pending $${fmt(mine.pending)} � notoriety ${mine.notoriety}</div>
        <button class="act" data-do="POST /v1/speakeasy/collect" style="border-color:var(--neon)"${groundOff('The bar take')}>collect the bar take</button>

          <button class="act" id="sp-name-go">${mine.name ? 'rename' : 'name it'} (${sp.nameOmr} $OMR)</button></div>
        <div style="margin-top:6px" class="d">Decor style${mine.decor ? ` - currently <b>${mine.decorName}</b>` : ' - stock'}:
          ${(() => { const earned = Object.keys(b.styleUnlocks || {}).filter((s) => (rn.renown || 0) >= b.styleUnlocks[s]);
            const avail = [...new Set([...ownedDecor, ...earned])];
            return avail.length ? avail.map((s) => `<button class="act" data-decor="${s}"${mine.decor === s ? ' style="border-color:var(--neon)"' : ''}>${styles[s] || s}${earned.includes(s) && !ownedDecor.includes(s) ? ' ?' : ''}</button>`).join(' ') + (mine.decor ? ' <button class="act" data-decor="">clear to stock</button>' : '')
              : '<span style="color:var(--dim)">buy a style in The Store, or earn one with renown (?)</span>'; })()}</div>
        <div style="margin-top:6px" class="d">${mine.salePrice ? `On the market for $${fmt(mine.salePrice)} - <button class="act" id="sp-unlist">take it off</button>` : `Sell the house: <input id="sp-sale" placeholder="ask $" size="8"> <button class="act" id="sp-list">list it</button>`}</div></div>`
      : canOpenHere ? `<div class="card"><span class="t">Open a club here</span>
          <div class="d">${esc(distName(me.loc))} has no house yet - plant your flag ($${fmt(sp.openCost)}, level ${sp.minLevel}+).</div>
          <button class="act" id="sp-open" style="border-color:var(--neon)"${(me.level || 0) >= (sp.minLevel || 15) ? '' : ' disabled'}>${(me.level || 0) >= (sp.minLevel || 15) ? '' : `?? lvl ${sp.minLevel}+ - `}open the club ($${fmt(sp.openCost)})</button></div>`
      : ''}

      ${here && !here.mine ? `
      <h2 style="margin-top:12px">Tonight at ${esc(here.name || distName(here.district))} <span class="d" style="font-size:11px">(${here.owner}'s house${here.shut ? ' � DARK - raided' : ''})</span></h2>
      ${here.shut ? '<div class="d" style="color:var(--bad)">The place is shuttered - the Prohibition boys shut it down. Come back later.</div>' : `
      <div class="card"><div class="d">Buy the house a round - the owner keeps 98%, and your name goes up on the guest list.</div>
        ${(sp.rounds || []).map((r) => `<button class="act" data-round="${r.id}">${esc(r.name)} ($${fmt(r.cost)})</button>`).join(' ')}
        <div style="margin-top:6px" class="d">Bottle service - burn $OMR for pure prestige:</div>
        ${(sp.bottles || []).map((x) => `<button class="act" data-bottle="${x.id}">${esc(x.name)} (${x.omr} $OMR)</button>`).join(' ')}
        <div style="margin-top:6px" class="d">The back-room table - the wheel ($${fmt(sp.table?.minBet || 1000)}-$${fmt(sp.table?.maxBet || 100000)}, the house takes ${(sp.table?.rakeBps ?? 300) / 100}%):</div>
        <input id="sp-bet" placeholder="bet $" size="8"> <button class="act" id="sp-table">spin the wheel</button></div>`}`
      : here && here.mine ? '<div class="d" style="color:var(--dim);margin-top:8px">You own this room - order a bottle to flex, but you don\'t buy your own rounds or play your own table.</div>' : ''}
      ${here && here.mine ? `<div class="card">${(sp.bottles || []).map((x) => `<button class="act" data-bottle="${x.id}">${esc(x.name)} (${x.omr} $OMR)</button>`).join(' ')}</div>` : ''}

      <h2 style="margin-top:12px">The Nightlife <span class="d" style="font-size:11px">(ranked by prestige - where the city goes to be seen)</span></h2>
      <div class="grid">${(b.clubs || []).map((c) => `
        <div class="card">${aart('club', c.tier)}<span class="t">${esc(c.name || distName(c.district))}</span>${c.mine ? '<span class="chip good">yours</span>' : ''}${c.decorName ? `<span class="chip">${c.decorName}</span>` : ''}${c.salePrice && !c.mine ? `<span class="chip gold">for sale $${fmt(c.salePrice)}</span>` : ''}
          <div class="d">${esc(distName(c.district))} � ${esc(c.tierName)} � ${c.owner} � prestige ${c.prestige} � ${c.regulars} regular${c.regulars === 1 ? '' : 's'}</div>
          ${c.guestList?.length ? `<div class="d">seen here: ${c.guestList.map((g) => `${g.you ? '<b>' + esc(g.name) + '</b>' : esc(g.name)}${g.regular ? '?' : ''}`).join(', ')}</div>` : '<div class="d" style="color:var(--dim)">quiet tonight</div>'}
          ${!c.mine && c.district !== me.loc ? `<button class="act" data-travel="${c.district}">go there</button>` : ''}
          ${c.salePrice && !c.mine && !mine && c.district === me.loc ? `<button class="act" data-buy="${c.district}" style="border-color:var(--gold)">buy it out ($${fmt(c.salePrice)})</button>` : ''}
          ${!c.mine && !mine && c.district === me.loc && !c.shut ? (c.standoverProtected ? '<span class="chip">just leaned on - cooling off</span>' : `<button class="act" data-standover="${c.district}" style="border-color:var(--bad)">stand over it (fee $${fmt(b.standover?.fee || 250000)}, forces a sale at $${fmt(c.assessedValue)})</button>`) : ''}</div>`).join('')
        || '<span class="d" style="color:var(--dim)">no clubs open yet - be the first proprietor</span>'}</div>
      ${b.open?.length ? `<div class="d" style="color:var(--dim);margin-top:8px">Open districts: ${b.open.map((x) => esc(distName(x))).join(', ')} - travel there to plant a flag.</div>` : ''}`;

    t.querySelectorAll('[data-round]').forEach((x) => x.onclick = () => act('POST', `/v1/speakeasy/${me.loc}/round`, { round: x.dataset.round }).then(() => renderSpeakeasy()));
    t.querySelectorAll('[data-bottle]').forEach((x) => x.onclick = () => act('POST', `/v1/speakeasy/${me.loc}/bottle`, { bottle: x.dataset.bottle }).then(() => renderSpeakeasy()));
    t.querySelectorAll('[data-travel]').forEach((x) => x.onclick = () => act('POST', `/v1/travel/${x.dataset.travel}`, {}).then(() => renderSpeakeasy()));
    const tb = $('#sp-table'); if (tb) tb.onclick = () => act('POST', `/v1/speakeasy/${me.loc}/table`, { bet: Number($('#sp-bet').value) }).then(() => renderSpeakeasy());

    const li = $('#sp-list'); if (li) li.onclick = () => act('POST', '/v1/speakeasy/list', { price: Number($('#sp-sale').value) }).then(() => renderSpeakeasy());

    t.querySelectorAll('[data-standover]').forEach((x) => x.onclick = async () => {

      const nl = (await api('GET', '/v1/leaderboard/nightlife')).body || {};
      sheetModal('THE NIGHTLIFE - top of the scene',
        rankRows((nl.board || []).map((x) => ({ name: x.name, note: x.rank, val: fmt(x.renown), you: x.you })),
          'nobody has been seen out yet')); };
  }

  // �� THE FIGHTS: sign a contender, train them, stake them in PvP bouts ��

CALLOUT: ${b.champion.callout.challenger} has called out the champ${b.champion.callout.deadlineSeconds > 0 ? ` - the champ must accept within ${mins(b.champion.callout.deadlineSeconds)} or forfeit the belt` : ' - <span style="color:var(--bad)">accept overdue - forfeit imminent</span>'}

      <div class="grid">${stable.map((y) => `
        <div class="card" ${y.belt ? 'style="border-color:var(--neon)"' : ''}><span class="t">${y.belt ? '?? ' : ''}${esc(y.name)} <span class="chip good">${y.rank}</span> <span class="chip">${y.record}</span></span>
          ${y.injuredSeconds ? `<span class="chip bad">LAID UP - ${mins(y.injuredSeconds)}</span>` : ''}${y.exhibitionCdSeconds ? `<span class="chip">resting ${mins(y.exhibitionCdSeconds)}</span>` : ''}
          <div class="d">power ${y.power} � chin ${y.chin} � speed ${y.speed} � form ${y.form}</div>

          <div style="margin-top:4px" class="d">${y.boutLimit ? `Taking bouts up to $${fmt(y.boutLimit)} - <button class="act" data-unlist="${y.id}">stop</button>` : 'Take bouts:'}
            <input id="bx-stake-${y.id}" placeholder="stake $" size="7"> <button class="act" data-list="${y.id}">list</button></div>

        || '<span class="d" style="color:var(--dim)">no fighters yet</span>'}</div>

        <div class="d">$${fmt(b.recruitCost)}, level ${b.minLevel}+.</div>
        <input id="bx-name" placeholder="fighter name" size="18" maxlength="24"> <button class="act" id="bx-sign" style="border-color:var(--neon)"${(me.level || 0) >= (b.minLevel || 0) ? '' : ' disabled'}>${(me.level || 0) >= (b.minLevel || 0) ? '' : `?? lvl ${b.minLevel}+ - `}sign ($${fmt(b.recruitCost)})</button></div>` : ''}

      <h2 style="margin-top:12px">The Circuit <span class="d" style="font-size:11px">(other managers' fighters - belt holder first)</span></h2>

        <div class="card"><span class="t">${f.belt ? '?? ' : ''}${esc(f.name)}</span><span class="chip">${f.rank}</span>
          <div class="d">${f.manager} � ${f.record} � form ${f.form}${f.injured ? ' � <span style="color:var(--bad)">laid up</span>' : ''}${f.boutLimit ? ' � takes $' + fmt(f.boutLimit) : ''}</div>
          ${f.taking && ready.length ? `<div style="margin-top:4px" class="d">
            <select id="bx-my-${f.fighterId}">${ready.map((m) => `<option value="${m.id}">${esc(m.name)} (${m.form})</option>`).join('')}</select>
            <input id="bx-purse-${f.fighterId}" placeholder="purse $" size="7"> <button class="act" data-fight="${f.managerId}" data-oppf="${f.fighterId}" style="border-color:var(--bad)">make the match${f.belt ? ' (TITLE)' : ''}</button>
            <button class="act" data-announce="${f.managerId}" data-oppf="${f.fighterId}" title="book a scheduled card the crowd bets on - no cash wager, just the belt/legend/record">headline it ??</button></div>` : ''}</div>`).join('')
        || '<span class="d" style="color:var(--dim)">no other fighters on the circuit yet</span>'}</div>

      <h2 style="margin-top:12px">The Main Event <span class="d" style="font-size:11px">(scheduled cards - bet CASH on a fighter; the crowd's pot pays out at the bell)</span></h2>
      <div class="grid">${(b.mainEvents || []).map((m) => {
        const total = m.a.pool + m.b.pool, oddsA = total ? Math.round(m.a.pool / total * 100) : 50;
        return `<div class="card"><span class="t">${esc(m.a.name)} vs ${esc(m.b.name)}</span> <span class="chip">closes ${mins(m.closesSeconds)}</span>${m.isPrincipal ? ' <span class="chip good">your card</span>' : ''}
          <!-- the crowd's money as a TUG-OF-WAR, which is the one place a bar carries real meaning
               here: two fighters, one pot, and where the room is leaning. It was two percentages. -->
          <div class="row" style="margin:7px 0 2px;font-size:12px"><span>${esc(m.a.name)}</span><span class="k">pot $${fmt(total)}</span><span>${esc(m.b.name)}</span></div>
          <div class="bar tug" style="height:12px;margin:0 0 3px"><i style="width:${oddsA}%"></i></div>
          <div class="row" style="margin:0 0 4px;font-size:11.5px"><span class="k">$${fmt(m.a.pool)} (${oddsA}%)</span><span class="k">$${fmt(m.b.pool)} (${100 - oddsA}%)</span></div>
          ${m.yourBet ? `<div class="d" style="color:var(--neon)">your bet: $${fmt(m.yourBet.amount)} on ${m.yourBet.on}</div>`
            : (m.isPrincipal || m.closesSeconds <= 0) ? '' : `<div style="margin-top:4px" class="d">
              <input id="bx-bet-${m.id}" placeholder="$${fmt(b.betMin)}-${fmt(b.betMax)}" size="9">
              <button class="act" data-bet="${m.id}" data-bf="${m.a.fighterId}">on ${esc(m.a.name)}</button>
              <button class="act" data-bet="${m.id}" data-bf="${m.b.fighterId}">on ${esc(m.b.name)}</button></div>`}</div>`;
      }).join('') || '<span class="d" style="color:var(--dim)">no cards booked - headline a matchup above to draw a crowd</span>'}</div>
      <div style="margin-top:8px"><a href="#" id="bx-lb">the circuit leaderboard + the manager legend </a></div>`;

    const bx = $('#bx-sign'); if (bx) bx.onclick = () => act('POST', '/v1/boxing/recruit', { name: $('#bx-name').value.trim() }).then(() => renderBoxing());
    t.querySelectorAll('[data-train]').forEach((x) => x.onclick = () => act('POST', '/v1/boxing/train', { fighter: x.dataset.fid, stat: x.dataset.train }).then(() => renderBoxing()));
    t.querySelectorAll('[data-list]').forEach((x) => x.onclick = () => act('POST', '/v1/boxing/list', { fighter: x.dataset.list, stake: Number(($(`#bx-stake-${x.dataset.list}`) || {}).value || 0) }).then(() => renderBoxing()));
    t.querySelectorAll('[data-unlist]').forEach((x) => x.onclick = () => act('POST', '/v1/boxing/list', { fighter: x.dataset.unlist, stake: 0 }).then(() => renderBoxing()));
    t.querySelectorAll('[data-exhib]').forEach((x) => x.onclick = () => act('POST', '/v1/boxing/exhibition', { fighter: x.dataset.exhib, tier: x.dataset.tier }).then(() => renderBoxing()));
    t.querySelectorAll('[data-fight]').forEach((x) => x.onclick = () => {
      const oppF = x.dataset.oppf, myF = ($(`#bx-my-${oppF}`) || {}).value, stake = Number(($(`#bx-purse-${oppF}`) || {}).value || 0);
      act('POST', `/v1/boxing/fight/${x.dataset.fight}`, { myFighter: myF, theirFighter: oppF, stake }).then(() => renderBoxing());
    });
    t.querySelectorAll('[data-announce]').forEach((x) => x.onclick = () => {
      const oppF = x.dataset.oppf, myF = ($(`#bx-my-${oppF}`) || {}).value;
      act('POST', `/v1/boxing/announce/${x.dataset.announce}`, { myFighter: myF, theirFighter: oppF }).then(() => renderBoxing());
    });
    t.querySelectorAll('[data-bet]').forEach((x) => x.onclick = () =>
      act('POST', `/v1/boxing/bout/${x.dataset.bet}/bet`, { fighter: x.dataset.bf, amount: Number(($(`#bx-bet-${x.dataset.bet}`) || {}).value || 0) }).then(() => renderBoxing()));
    const bxc = $('#bx-callout'); if (bxc) bxc.onclick = () => act('POST', `/v1/boxing/callout/${bxc.dataset.cf}`, null).then(() => renderBoxing());
    const bxa = $('#bx-accept'); if (bxa) bxa.onclick = () => act('POST', '/v1/boxing/callout/accept', null).then(() => renderBoxing());
    const lb = $('#bx-lb'); if (lb) lb.onclick = async (e) => { e.preventDefault();
      const d = (await api('GET', '/v1/leaderboard/boxing')).body || {};
      sheetModal('THE FIGHT CIRCUIT',
        `<h3 style="color:var(--dim);font-size:12px;letter-spacing:2px;margin:2px 0 4px">TOP FIGHTERS</h3>`
        + rankRows((d.fighters || []).map((x) => ({ name: `${x.belt ? '?? ' : ''}${x.fighter}`, note: `${x.manager} � ${x.rank}`, val: x.record })), 'no fighters ranked yet')
        + `<h3 style="color:var(--dim);font-size:12px;letter-spacing:2px;margin:16px 0 4px">MANAGER LEGEND - lifetime wins</h3>`
        + rankRows((d.legend || []).map((x) => ({ name: x.manager, note: x.title, val: `${x.wins} wins` })), 'no manager has banked a win yet')); };
  }

  // �� THE STABLE: own the dogs & the ponies (buy/train/list/circuit(PvE)/match(PvP) + the legend) ��
  async function renderStable() {
    const t = $('#tab-stable');
    await refresh();
    const b = (await api('GET', '/v1/stable')).body || {};
    const stable = b.stable || [], max = b.stableMax || 4;
    const ready = stable.filter((r) => !r.injuredSeconds); // your racers available for a match
    const kinds = b.kinds || {}, meets = b.meets || {};
    const kindName = (k) => (kinds[k] || {}).name || k;
    t.innerHTML = `
      ${!stable.length ? coachCard('Buy a racer', 'Own the dogs &amp; the ponies. Buy a greyhound ($' + fmt((kinds.dog || {}).cost || 30000) + ') or a racehorse ($' + fmt((kinds.horse || {}).cost || 120000) + ', level ' + (b.minLevel || 6) + '+), train up its speed/stamina/heart, and race it - the PvE circuit for a purse, or match it against a rival owner\'s racer for a cash wager. Run a stable of up to ' + max + '. They die with your street; your lifetime wins are a legend that survives.') : ''}
      <h2>The Stable <span class="d" style="font-size:11px">(${stable.length}/${max})</span> ${b.legend ? `<span class="chip good" style="font-size:11px">${esc(b.legend.title)} - ${b.legend.wins} career win${b.legend.wins === 1 ? '' : 's'}</span>` : ''}</h2>
      <div class="grid">${stable.map((y) => `
        <div class="card"><span class="t">${y.kind === 'horse' ? '??' : '??'} ${esc(y.name)} <span class="chip good">${y.rank}</span> <span class="chip">${y.record}</span></span>
          ${y.injuredSeconds ? `<span class="chip bad">LAID UP - ${mins(y.injuredSeconds)}</span>` : ''}${y.cooldownSeconds ? `<span class="chip">resting ${mins(y.cooldownSeconds)}</span>` : ''}
          <div class="d">${kindName(y.kind)} � speed ${y.speed} � stamina ${y.stamina} � heart ${y.heart} � form ${y.form}</div>
          <div style="margin-top:6px" class="d">Train ($${fmt(b.trainCost)} + energy, cap ${b.statCap}): ${(b.stats || []).map((s) => `<button class="act" data-train="${s}" data-rid="${y.id}">${s}</button>`).join(' ')}</div>
          <div style="margin-top:4px" class="d">${y.raceLimit ? `Taking matches up to $${fmt(y.raceLimit)} - <button class="act" data-unlist="${y.id}">stop</button>` : 'Take matches:'}
            <input id="st-stake-${y.id}" placeholder="wager $" size="7"> <button class="act" data-list="${y.id}">list</button></div>
          ${!y.injuredSeconds && !y.cooldownSeconds ? `<div style="margin-top:4px" class="d">Run the circuit: ${(meets[y.kind] || []).map((m) => `<button class="act" data-circuit="${y.id}" data-meet="${m.id}" title="entry $${fmt(m.fee)}  win $${fmt(m.purse)}">${esc(m.name)}</button>`).join(' ')}</div>` : ''}</div>`).join('')
        || '<span class="d" style="color:var(--dim)">no racers yet</span>'}</div>
      ${stable.length < max ? `<div class="card" style="margin-top:6px"><span class="t">Buy a racer</span>
        <div class="d">level ${b.minLevel}+.</div>
        <select id="st-kind">${Object.entries(kinds).map(([k, v]) => `<option value="${k}">${esc(v.name)} ($${fmt(v.cost)})</option>`).join('')}</select>
        <input id="st-name" placeholder="racer name" size="16" maxlength="24"> <button class="act" id="st-buy" style="border-color:var(--neon)"${(me.level || 0) >= (b.minLevel || 0) ? '' : ' disabled'}>${(me.level || 0) >= (b.minLevel || 0) ? '' : `?? lvl ${b.minLevel}+ - `}buy</button></div>` : ''}
      ${stable.length >= 2 ? `<div class="card" style="margin-top:6px"><span class="t">Breed a foal <span class="d" style="font-size:11px">($${fmt(b.breedCost || 60000)} - retires both parents into a foal that inherits their form)</span></span>
        <div class="d" style="margin-top:4px">sire: <select id="st-sire">${stable.map((y) => `<option value="${y.id}" data-kind="${y.kind}">${esc(y.name)} (${esc(y.kindName)})</option>`).join('')}</select>
          dam: <select id="st-dam">${stable.map((y) => `<option value="${y.id}" data-kind="${y.kind}">${esc(y.name)} (${esc(y.kindName)})</option>`).join('')}</select>
          <input id="st-foal" placeholder="foal name" size="14" maxlength="24"> <button class="act" id="st-breed">breed (same kind)</button></div></div>` : ''}

      <h2 style="margin-top:12px">The Stakes <span class="d" style="font-size:11px">(the marquee - enter your racer, the town's best animal takes the purse)</span></h2>
      ${(() => { const sk = b.stakes || {};
        if (!sk.open) return `<div class="d" style="color:var(--dim);font-size:12.5px">No stakes running. Enter a racer ($${fmt(sk.buyin)} buy-in) to open one - the top ${(sk.payouts || []).length} split the purse (min ${sk.minEntrants} runners or it refunds).</div>
          ${ready.length ? `<div style="margin-top:4px"><select id="st-enter">${ready.map((m) => `<option value="${m.id}">${esc(m.name)} (form ${m.form})</option>`).join('')}</select> <button class="act" id="st-stake" style="border-color:var(--gold)">enter the stakes ($${fmt(sk.buyin)})</button></div>` : '<div class="d" style="color:var(--dim)">no fit racer to enter</div>'}`;
        return `<div class="card"><span class="t">purse $${fmt(sk.pool)}</span> <span class="chip">${sk.entrants} in</span> <span class="chip">closes ${mins(sk.closesSeconds)}</span>${sk.mine ? ' <span class="chip good">you\'re in</span>' : ''}
          <div class="d">field: ${(sk.field || []).map((f) => `${f.kind === 'horse' ? '??' : '??'} ${f.racer} (${f.form})`).join(' � ') || '-'}</div>
          ${!sk.mine && ready.length ? `<div style="margin-top:4px"><select id="st-enter">${ready.map((m) => `<option value="${m.id}">${esc(m.name)} (form ${m.form})</option>`).join('')}</select> <button class="act" id="st-stake" style="border-color:var(--gold)">enter ($${fmt(sk.buyin)})</button></div>` : ''}</div>`; })()}

      <h2 style="margin-top:12px">The Field <span class="d" style="font-size:11px">(other owners' racers - match your own kind for a cash wager)</span></h2>
      <div class="grid">${(b.field || []).filter((r) => !r.mine).map((r) => `
        <div class="card"><span class="t">${r.kind === 'horse' ? '??' : '??'} ${esc(r.name)}</span><span class="chip">${r.rank}</span>
          <div class="d">${r.owner} � ${r.record} � form ${r.form}${r.injured ? ' � <span style="color:var(--bad)">laid up</span>' : ''}${r.raceLimit ? ' � takes $' + fmt(r.raceLimit) : ''}</div>
          ${r.taking && ready.some((m) => m.kind === r.kind) ? `<div style="margin-top:4px" class="d">
            <select id="st-my-${r.racerId}">${ready.filter((m) => m.kind === r.kind).map((m) => `<option value="${m.id}">${esc(m.name)} (${m.form})</option>`).join('')}</select>
            <input id="st-wager-${r.racerId}" placeholder="wager $" size="7"> <button class="act" data-match="${r.ownerId}" data-oppr="${r.racerId}" style="border-color:var(--bad)">race them</button></div>` : ''}</div>`).join('')
        || '<span class="d" style="color:var(--dim)">no other racers on the card yet</span>'}</div>
      <div style="margin-top:8px"><a href="#" id="st-lb">the field board + the owner legend </a></div>`;

    const sb = $('#st-buy'); if (sb) sb.onclick = () => act('POST', '/v1/stable/buy', { kind: $('#st-kind').value, name: $('#st-name').value.trim() }).then(() => renderStable());
    const sbr = $('#st-breed'); if (sbr) sbr.onclick = () => act('POST', '/v1/stable/breed', { sire: $('#st-sire').value, dam: $('#st-dam').value, name: $('#st-foal').value.trim() }).then(() => renderStable());
    const ss = $('#st-stake'); if (ss) ss.onclick = () => act('POST', `/v1/stable/stakes/${$('#st-enter').value}`, null).then(() => renderStable());
    t.querySelectorAll('[data-train]').forEach((x) => x.onclick = () => act('POST', `/v1/stable/train/${x.dataset.rid}`, { stat: x.dataset.train }).then(() => renderStable()));
    t.querySelectorAll('[data-list]').forEach((x) => x.onclick = () => act('POST', `/v1/stable/list/${x.dataset.list}`, { limit: Number(($(`#st-stake-${x.dataset.list}`) || {}).value || 0) }).then(() => renderStable()));
    t.querySelectorAll('[data-unlist]').forEach((x) => x.onclick = () => act('POST', `/v1/stable/list/${x.dataset.unlist}`, { limit: 0 }).then(() => renderStable()));
    t.querySelectorAll('[data-circuit]').forEach((x) => x.onclick = () => act('POST', `/v1/stable/circuit/${x.dataset.circuit}`, { meet: x.dataset.meet }).then(() => renderStable()));
    t.querySelectorAll('[data-match]').forEach((x) => x.onclick = () => {
      const oppR = x.dataset.oppr, myR = ($(`#st-my-${oppR}`) || {}).value, stake = Number(($(`#st-wager-${oppR}`) || {}).value || 0);
      act('POST', `/v1/stable/match/${x.dataset.match}`, { myRacer: myR, theirRacer: oppR, stake }).then(() => renderStable());
    });
    const lb = $('#st-lb'); if (lb) lb.onclick = async (e) => { e.preventDefault();
      const d = (await api('GET', '/v1/leaderboard/stable')).body || {};
      sheetModal('THE STABLE',
        `<h3 style="color:var(--dim);font-size:12px;letter-spacing:2px;margin:2px 0 4px">TOP RACERS</h3>`
        + rankRows((d.racers || []).map((x) => ({ name: `${x.kind === 'horse' ? '??' : '??'} ${x.racer}`, note: `${x.owner} � ${x.rank}`, val: x.record })), 'no racers ranked yet')
        + `<h3 style="color:var(--dim);font-size:12px;letter-spacing:2px;margin:16px 0 4px">OWNER LEGEND - lifetime wins</h3>`
        + rankRows((d.legend || []).map((x) => ({ name: x.owner, note: x.title, val: `${x.wins} wins` })), 'no owner has banked a win yet')); };
  }

  // �� STREET RACES: the car catalog as a competitive loop (PvE circuit + tuning + PvP wagers) ��
  async function renderRaces() {
    const t = $('#tab-races');
    await refresh();
    const b = (await api('GET', '/v1/races')).body || {};
    const cars = b.cars || [], strip = b.strip || [], tiers = b.tiers || [];
    const cd = b.cooldownSeconds || 0;
    const carOpts = cars.map((c) => `<option value="${c.id}">${c.model} - power ${c.power}${c.tune ? ` (tune ${c.tune})` : ''}${c.nos ? ` � ${c.nos} NOS` : ''}${c.dmg ? ` � ${c.dmg}% dmg` : ''}</option>`).join('');
    const nosMax = b.nos?.max || 3;
    // A LOCKED CONTROL SAYS SO BEFORE IT IS PRESSED. The tier chips and the Grand Prix card
    // used to state their level requirement in prose beside a live button, so the refusal only
    // arrived as a toast after the click. Both now read the same `minLvl`/`minLevel` the server
    // enforces and disable themselves with the requirement on the face of the button.
    const gpOk = (me.level || 0) >= ((b.grandPrix || {}).minLevel || 0);
    t.innerHTML = `
      ${!cars.length ? coachCard('Get some iron on the strip', 'Street racing turns your garage into a competitive loop. Boost or buy a car, tune it, and race the NPC circuit for a purse - or list it and take wagers off other drivers. Fast, valuable, well-tuned iron wins; the wheelman\'s speed decides close ones.') : ''}
      <h2>Street Races <span class="chip">?? ${b.legend?.rank || 'Sunday Driver'} � ${b.legend?.wins || 0} wins</span></h2>
      ${cd > 0 ? `<div class="card"><div class="d">Your ride is cooling down - next run in ${mins(cd)}.</div></div>` : ''}
      <div class="grid">
        <div class="card"><span class="t">The Circuit (PvE)</span>
          <div class="d">Pay the buy-in (burns win or lose), beat the NPC pack for the purse. A loss dings your car.</div>
          <div class="row" style="margin-top:6px"><select id="rc-car">${carOpts}</select><button class="act nosbtn" id="rc-nos-npc" data-armed="0" title="arm the bottle for this run">NOS +${b.nos?.power || 60}</button></div>
          ${tiers.map((ti) => { const ok = (me.level || 0) >= ti.minLvl; return `<div class="row" style="margin-top:4px"><span>${esc(ti.name)} <span class="chip"${ok ? '' : ' style="color:var(--dim)"'}>${ok ? `lvl ${ti.minLvl}` : `?? lvl ${ti.minLvl}+`}</span></span><span>fee $${fmt(ti.fee)} � purse $${fmt(ti.purse)} <button class="act" data-npc="${ti.id}"${cd > 0 || !cars.length || !ok ? ' disabled' : ''}>race</button></span></div>`; }).join('')}
        </div>
        <div class="card"><span class="t">Your Garage</span>
          ${cars.length ? cars.map((c) => `<div class="row" style="margin-top:4px"><span>${c.model} - <b>power ${c.power}</b>${c.rarity && c.rarity !== 'common' ? ` � <span class="chip good">${esc(c.rarity.toUpperCase())} utility</span>` : ''}${c.nos ? ` � <span class="chip good">?? ${c.nos} NOS</span>` : ''}${c.dmg ? ` � <span style="color:var(--bad)">${c.dmg}% dmg</span>` : ''}${c.raceLimit ? ` � <span class="chip good">racing � $${fmt(c.raceLimit)}</span>` : ''}${c.pinkSlip ? ' � <span class="chip" style="color:var(--bad)">?? up for pinks</span>' : ''}</span>
            <span><button class="act" data-tune="${c.id}"${c.tune >= (b.tune?.max || 5) ? ' disabled' : ''}>tune $${fmt(b.tune?.cost || 25000)} (${c.tune}/${b.tune?.max || 5})</button>
            <button class="act" data-nos="${c.id}"${(c.nos || 0) >= nosMax ? ' disabled' : ''}>NOS $${fmt(b.nos?.cost || 8000)} (${c.nos || 0}/${nosMax})</button>
            <button class="act" data-pink="${c.id}" data-on="${c.pinkSlip ? '0' : '1'}">${c.pinkSlip ? 'pull pinks' : 'put up pinks'}</button>
            ${c.raceLimit ? `<button class="act" data-unlist="${c.id}">pull</button>` : `<input id="rc-lim-${c.id}" type="number" placeholder="list for $" style="width:96px"><button class="act" data-list="${c.id}">list</button>`}</span></div>`).join('') : '<div class="d">No cars - boost or buy some iron first.</div>'}
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="card"><span class="t">The Strip (PvP)</span>
        <div class="d">Other drivers' cars taking a race. Wager races: pick your own ride, name a wager up to their limit - winner takes the pot minus a 5% rake, the loser's car takes damage. <b style="color:var(--bad)">?? pinks</b> races have no cash - the winner <b>takes the loser's car</b>.</div>
        ${strip.length ? strip.map((s) => `<div class="row" style="margin-top:4px"><span>${s.owner}'s ${s.model} <span class="chip">${s.band}</span>${s.limit ? ` � up to $${fmt(s.limit)}` : ''}${s.forPinks ? ' � <span class="chip" style="color:var(--bad)">?? for pinks</span>' : ''}</span>
          <span><select class="rc-mycar" data-for="${s.carId}">${carOpts}</select><button class="act nosbtn rc-nos" data-for="${s.carId}" data-armed="0">NOS</button>
          ${s.limit ? `<input id="rc-w-${s.carId}" type="number" placeholder="wager $" style="width:90px"><button class="act" data-race="${s.ownerId}" data-car="${s.carId}"${cd > 0 ? ' disabled' : ''}>race</button>` : ''}
          ${s.forPinks ? `<button class="act" data-pinkrace="${s.ownerId}" data-car="${s.carId}"${cd > 0 ? ' disabled' : ''} style="color:var(--bad)">?? for pinks</button>` : ''}</span></div>`).join('') : '<div class="d">Nobody\'s on the strip right now. List one of your own - for a wager or for pinks - to draw a challenger.</div>'}
      </div>
      ${b.grandPrix ? `<div class="card"><span class="t">The Grand Prix <span class="chip">the big race</span></span>
        <div class="d">A scheduled cash race - buy in with your best iron, the whole grid runs at once, the top 3 split the pot (minus a 5% cut). Pure skill + variance; no one takes your car.</div>
        ${b.grandPrix.open ? `<div class="row" style="margin-top:6px"><span>?? pool $${fmt(b.grandPrix.pool)} � ${b.grandPrix.entrants} on the grid${b.grandPrix.closesSeconds ? ` � grid closes in ${mins(b.grandPrix.closesSeconds)}` : ' � about to run'}${b.grandPrix.entered ? ' � <span class="chip good">you\'re in</span>' : ''}</span>
          ${!b.grandPrix.entered ? `<span><select id="rc-gp-car">${carOpts}</select><button class="act" id="rc-gp"${!cars.length || !gpOk ? ' disabled' : ''}>${gpOk ? '' : `?? lvl ${b.grandPrix.minLevel}+ - `}enter - $${fmt(b.grandPrix.buyin)}</button></span>` : '<span class="chip">good luck out there</span>'}</div>`
          : `<div class="row" style="margin-top:6px"><span class="d">No race on the card. Enter to open one (level ${b.grandPrix.minLevel}+, ${b.grandPrix.minEntrants}+ runners or the field is refunded).</span><span><select id="rc-gp-car">${carOpts}</select><button class="act" id="rc-gp"${!cars.length || !gpOk ? ' disabled' : ''}>${gpOk ? '' : `?? lvl ${b.grandPrix.minLevel}+ - `}open it - $${fmt(b.grandPrix.buyin)}</button></span></div>`}
      </div>` : ''}
      <button class="act" id="rc-lb">?? THE WHEEL - the leaderboard</button>`;
    { const gp = $('#rc-gp'); if (gp) gp.onclick = () => act('POST', '/v1/races/gp', { car: $('#rc-gp-car').value }).then(() => renderRaces()); }
    // NOS is the most cinematic mechanic in the game and it was a CHECKBOX. Arming a bottle should
    // feel like arming a bottle - it lights, it hums, and it says ARMED.
    t.querySelectorAll('.nosbtn').forEach((x) => x.onclick = () => {
      const on = x.dataset.armed !== '1';
      x.dataset.armed = on ? '1' : '0';
      x.classList.toggle('armed', on);
      x.textContent = on ? '?? NOS ARMED' : x.id === 'rc-nos-npc' ? `NOS +${b.nos?.power || 60}` : 'NOS';
      haptic(on ? 'success' : 'tap');
    });
    t.querySelectorAll('[data-npc]').forEach((x) => x.onclick = () => act('POST', '/v1/races/npc', { car: $('#rc-car').value, tier: x.dataset.npc, nos: $('#rc-nos-npc')?.dataset.armed === '1' }).then(() => renderRaces()));
    t.querySelectorAll('[data-tune]').forEach((x) => x.onclick = () => act('POST', `/v1/races/tune/${x.dataset.tune}`, null).then(() => renderRaces()));
    t.querySelectorAll('[data-nos]').forEach((x) => x.onclick = () => act('POST', `/v1/races/nos/${x.dataset.nos}`, null).then(() => renderRaces()));
    t.querySelectorAll('[data-pink]').forEach((x) => x.onclick = () => act('POST', `/v1/races/pinkslip/${x.dataset.pink}`, { on: x.dataset.on === '1' }).then(() => renderRaces()));
    t.querySelectorAll('[data-list]').forEach((x) => x.onclick = () => act('POST', `/v1/races/list/${x.dataset.list}`, { limit: Number(($(`#rc-lim-${x.dataset.list}`) || {}).value || 0) }).then(() => renderRaces()));
    t.querySelectorAll('[data-unlist]').forEach((x) => x.onclick = () => act('POST', `/v1/races/unlist/${x.dataset.unlist}`, null).then(() => renderRaces()));
    t.querySelectorAll('[data-race]').forEach((x) => x.onclick = () => {
      const myCar = (t.querySelector(`.rc-mycar[data-for="${x.dataset.car}"]`) || {}).value;
      const nos = (t.querySelector(`.rc-nos[data-for="${x.dataset.car}"]`) || {}).dataset?.armed === '1';
      act('POST', `/v1/races/challenge/${x.dataset.race}`, { myCar, theirCar: x.dataset.car, wager: Number(($(`#rc-w-${x.dataset.car}`) || {}).value || 0), nos }).then(() => renderRaces());
    });
    t.querySelectorAll('[data-pinkrace]').forEach((x) => x.onclick = async () => {
      const myCar = (t.querySelector(`.rc-mycar[data-for="${x.dataset.car}"]`) || {}).value;
      const nos = (t.querySelector(`.rc-nos[data-for="${x.dataset.car}"]`) || {}).dataset?.armed === '1';
      if (!await ask('Race for pinks?', 'If you lose, the car you picked changes hands on the spot. There is no buy-back.', { yes: 'race for it', no: 'walk away', danger: true })) return;
      act('POST', `/v1/races/pinks/${x.dataset.pinkrace}`, { myCar, theirCar: x.dataset.car, nos }).then(() => renderRaces());
    });
    const lb = $('#rc-lb'); if (lb) lb.onclick = async () => {
      const d = (await api('GET', '/v1/leaderboard/races')).body?.drivers || [];
      sheetModal('THE WHEEL - winningest drivers',
        rankRows(d.map((x) => ({ name: x.name, note: x.rank, val: `${x.wins} wins` })), 'nobody has taken a race yet'));
    };
  }

  // �� THE PORT: maritime smuggling - boats + the run + the Coast Guard ��
  async function renderPort() {
    const t = $('#tab-port');
    await refresh();
    const b = (await api('GET', '/v1/port')).body || {};
    const fleet = b.fleet || [], routes = b.routes || [], cat = b.catalog || [];
    // A LANE YOU CANNOT RUN SAYS SO, IN THE PICKER. The board sends `minLvl` per route and this list
    // ignored it, so every lane looked available: you picked one, pressed "run it", and the server
    // answered `route_level` - the tester's report, verbatim ("I tab to the run it button and it says
    // I can't till level 6"). A locked lane is still LISTED, because seeing what the deep runs pay is
    // the reason to level toward them; it just cannot be chosen.
    const canRun = (r) => (me.level || 0) >= (r.minLvl || 0);
    const routeOpts = routes.map((r) => `<option value="${r.id}"${canRun(r) ? '' : ' disabled'}>${canRun(r) ? '' : `?? lvl ${r.minLvl}+ - `}${esc(r.name)} - buy $${fmt(r.buy)}/u � sell $${fmt(r.sell)}/u � ~${r.interdictPct}% caught${r.hot ? ' � ??HOT LANE' : ''}</option>`).join('');
    const anyRoute = routes.some(canRun);
    const rep = b.reputation || {};
    const repLine = (rep.coolsFaster || rep.tollBreak || rep.quieter)
      ? `<span class="chip" style="color:var(--gold)">reputation: ${[rep.coolsFaster && 'lanes cool 2x faster', rep.tollBreak && 'docks toll halved', rep.quieter && 'low profile - lanes heat half as fast'].filter(Boolean).join(' � ')}</span>`
      : `<span class="chip">earn the Smuggler ranks to manage your notoriety</span>`;
    t.innerHTML = `
      ${!fleet.length ? coachCard('Buy a boat, run the coast', 'The Port brings contraband in from offshore. Buy a boat at the docks (a hold for cargo, speed to slip the Coast Guard), load a run, and - if you make it home clean - fence the haul for the smuggling margin. Get caught and you lose the cargo, eat a fine, and might lose the boat. Distinct from convoys: this is the SEA, and the risk is the law, not other players.') : ''}
      <h2>The Port ${b.atDocks ? '' : '<span class="chip" style="color:var(--bad)">travel to the docks to trade</span>'}</h2>
      ${b.legend ? `<div class="card" style="border-color:var(--gold)"><span class="t">The Smuggler's Legend</span><div class="d"><b style="color:var(--gold)">${b.legend.rank}</b> - $${fmt(b.legend.smuggled)} landed for life <span class="chip">survives death</span> � <a href="#" id="pt-lb">the leaderboard </a></div></div>` : ''}
      <div class="card"><span class="t">The Supplier</span><div class="d">Contraband headroom today: <b>$${fmt(b.supplyLeft || 0)}</b> of $${fmt(b.supplyCap || 0)} - the offshore supplier only moves so much per day.
        ${(b.harbormaster && b.harbormaster.tolled) ? `<br><span class="chip" style="color:var(--bad)">${esc(art(b.harbormaster.holder.name))} [${esc(b.harbormaster.holder.tag)}] hold the docks - a ${(b.harbormaster.tollBps/100)}% toll on every clean landing</span>` : ''}</div></div>
      ${routes.length ? `<div class="card"><span class="t">Sea Lanes <span class="chip">route notoriety</span></span><div class="d">Run the same lane and the Coast Guard learns it - interdiction climbs. Vary your lanes to stay cool (they cool on their own).<br>
        ${routes.map((r) => `${esc(r.name)}: ~${r.interdictPct}% caught ${r.notoriety > 0 ? `<span class="chip ${r.hot ? 'bad' : ''}">heat ${r.notoriety}/${r.notorietyMax}${r.hot ? ' ??' : ''}</span>` : '<span class="chip good">cold</span>'}`).join(' � ')}<br>${repLine}</div></div>` : ''}
      ${b.contraband ? `<div class="card"><span class="t">The Warehouse & Fence</span><div class="d">Warehoused contraband: <b>$${fmt(b.contraband.book)}</b> book value � today's fence rate <b>${b.contraband.fenceRate}x</b>  ~$${fmt(b.contraband.estimate)} <span class="chip">time the market - warehouse a landing, fence high</span>${b.contraband.book > 0 ? ' <span class="chip bad">at risk - a killer loots half your stash, so don\'t sit on it marked</span>' : ''}
        ${b.contraband.book > 0 ? `<button class="act" data-fence="1"${b.atDocks ? '' : ' disabled'}>fence it all</button>` : ''}</div></div>` : ''}
      <div class="grid wide">
        <div class="card"><span class="t">Your Fleet <span class="chip">${fleet.length}/${b.fleetMax || 5}</span></span>
          ${fleet.length ? fleet.map((f) => `<div class="row" style="margin-top:4px"><span><img class="ico row" alt="" src="/v1/art/boat/${f.kind || ''}">${esc(f.name)} - hold ${f.hold} � ${f.speed} kn ${f.utilityBps ? `<span class="chip good">${esc(f.rarity.toUpperCase())} +${f.utilityBps / 100}% base</span>` : ''} ${f.status === 'at_sea' ? `<span class="chip">at sea � ${mins(f.etaSeconds)}</span>` : f.status === 'arrived' ? '<span class="chip good">home - collect</span>' : '<span class="chip">docked</span>'}</span>
            <span>${f.status === 'arrived' ? `<label style="font-size:.8em"><input type="checkbox" class="pt-wh" data-for="${f.id}"> warehouse</label> <button class="act" data-collect="${f.id}"${b.atDocks ? groundOff('The captain\'s take') : ' disabled'}>collect</button>` : f.status === 'docked' ? `<button class="act" data-sell="${f.id}"${b.atDocks ? '' : ' disabled'}>sell</button>` : ''}</span></div>
            ${f.status === 'docked' ? `<div class="row" style="margin-top:2px"><select class="pt-route" data-for="${f.id}">${routeOpts}</select><label style="font-size:.8em"><input type="checkbox" class="pt-esc" data-for="${f.id}"> escort +$${fmt((b.escort || {}).cost || 0)}</label><button class="act" data-run="${f.id}"${b.atDocks && anyRoute ? '' : ' disabled'}>run it</button>${anyRoute ? '' : `<span class="chip">no lane open to you yet - the first runs at lvl ${routes[0] ? routes[0].minLvl : 6}</span>`}</div>
            <div class="row" style="margin-top:2px;font-size:.85em"><span class="chip">hull ${f.hull}/${(b.upgrade||{}).max||5}</span>${f.hullCost ? `<button class="act" data-up="${f.id}" data-part="hull">+cargo $${fmt(f.hullCost)}</button>` : ''}
              <span class="chip">engine ${f.engine}/${(b.upgrade||{}).max||5}</span>${f.engineCost ? `<button class="act" data-up="${f.id}" data-part="engine">+knots $${fmt(f.engineCost)}</button>` : ''}
              <label style="font-size:.9em"><input type="checkbox" class="pt-rdv" data-for="${f.id}" ${f.rendezvous ? 'checked' : ''}> ready for a handoff</label></div>` : ''}
            ${f.status === 'at_sea' ? `<div class="row" style="margin-top:2px;font-size:.85em"><span class="d">hand off to a partner's boat:</span><input class="pt-to" data-for="${f.id}" placeholder="partner boat id" style="flex:1"><button class="act" data-rdv="${f.id}">rendezvous</button></div>` : ''}`).join('') : '<div class="d">No boats. Buy one below.</div>'}
        </div>
        <div class="card"><span class="t">The Boatyard</span>
          ${cat.map((c) => `<div class="row" style="margin-top:4px"><span><img class="ico row" alt="" src="/v1/art/boat/${c.id}">${esc(c.name)} - hold ${c.hold} � ${c.speed} kn</span><span>$${fmt(c.cost)} <button class="act" data-buy="${c.id}"${b.atDocks && fleet.length < (b.fleetMax || 5) ? '' : ' disabled'}>buy</button></span></div>`).join('')}
          <div class="d" style="margin-top:4px">Boats resell at ${Math.round(((cat[0]||{}).resale||0)/((cat[0]||{}).cost||1)*100)}% and die with your street.</div>
          ${b.berth ? `<div class="row" style="margin-top:4px"><span>Harbor slips <span class="chip">${b.berth.count}/${b.berth.max}</span> - +1 fleet cap each</span>${b.berth.count < b.berth.max ? `<button class="act" data-berth="1"${b.atDocks ? '' : ' disabled'}>rent $${fmt(b.berth.cost)}</button>` : ''}</div>` : ''}
        </div>
      </div>
      ${(b.seas && b.seas.length) ? `<div class="card" style="margin-top:12px"><span class="t">The Seas - runs out there now <span class="chip">piracy</span></span>
        <div class="d">Run down a rival's cargo with your own fast boat + guns (${(b.piracy||{}).ammo} rounds, ${(b.piracy||{}).energy} energy). A win takes a cut of the haul; a loss puts you in the water. ${b.atDocks ? '' : '<b>Travel to the docks to give chase.</b>'}</div>
        ${b.seas.map((s) => `<div class="row" style="margin-top:4px"><span><b>${s.runner}</b> - ${esc(s.routeName)} � <span class="chip">${s.band}</span> � in ${mins(s.etaSeconds)}</span><button class="act" data-pirate="${s.boatId}"${b.atDocks ? '' : ' disabled'}>run her down</button></div>`).join('')}
      </div>` : (me.level >= ((b.piracy||{}).minLevel||10) ? '<div class="card" style="margin-top:12px"><span class="t">The Seas</span><div class="d">No rival runs out there right now. Keep a fast boat docked and check back - a loaded run is worth chasing.</div></div>' : '')}`;
    t.querySelectorAll('[data-buy]').forEach((x) => x.onclick = () => act('POST', `/v1/port/boat/${x.dataset.buy}`, null).then(() => renderPort()));
    t.querySelectorAll('[data-sell]').forEach((x) => x.onclick = () => act('POST', `/v1/port/boat/${x.dataset.sell}/sell`, null).then(() => renderPort()));
    t.querySelectorAll('[data-collect]').forEach((x) => x.onclick = () => {
      const warehouse = (t.querySelector(`.pt-wh[data-for="${x.dataset.collect}"]`) || {}).checked;
      act('POST', `/v1/port/collect/${x.dataset.collect}`, warehouse ? { warehouse: true } : null).then(() => renderPort());
    });
    { const f = $('[data-fence]'); if (f) f.onclick = () => act('POST', '/v1/port/fence', null).then(() => renderPort()); }
    { const bt = $('[data-berth]'); if (bt) bt.onclick = () => act('POST', '/v1/port/berth', null).then(() => renderPort()); }
    { const plb = $('#pt-lb'); if (plb) plb.onclick = async (e) => { e.preventDefault();
      const d = (await api('GET', '/v1/leaderboard/port')).body?.smugglers || [];
      sheetModal("THE SMUGGLER'S LEGEND - biggest lifetime haul",
        rankRows(d.map((x) => ({ name: x.name, note: x.rank, val: `$${fmt(x.smuggled || 0)}` })), 'nothing has come ashore yet')); }; }
    t.querySelectorAll('[data-up]').forEach((x) => x.onclick = () => act('POST', `/v1/port/upgrade/${x.dataset.up}`, { part: x.dataset.part }).then(() => renderPort()));
    t.querySelectorAll('[data-pirate]').forEach((x) => x.onclick = () => act('POST', `/v1/port/intercept/${x.dataset.pirate}`, null).then(() => renderPort()));
    t.querySelectorAll('.pt-rdv').forEach((x) => x.onchange = () => act('POST', `/v1/port/boat/${x.dataset.for}/rendezvous`, { open: x.checked }).then(() => renderPort()));
    t.querySelectorAll('[data-rdv]').forEach((x) => x.onclick = () => {
      const to = (t.querySelector(`.pt-to[data-for="${x.dataset.rdv}"]`) || {}).value;
      act('POST', `/v1/port/rendezvous/${x.dataset.rdv}`, { to }).then(() => renderPort());
    });
    t.querySelectorAll('[data-run]').forEach((x) => x.onclick = () => {
      const route = (t.querySelector(`.pt-route[data-for="${x.dataset.run}"]`) || {}).value;
      const escort = (t.querySelector(`.pt-esc[data-for="${x.dataset.run}"]`) || {}).checked;
      act('POST', `/v1/port/run/${x.dataset.run}`, { route, escort }).then(() => renderPort());
    });
  }

  // �� BIG SCORES: the solo score, crew heists, smuggling convoys ��
  async function renderScores() {
    const t = $('#tab-scores');
    await refresh();
    const hb = (await api('GET', '/v1/heists')).body || {};
    const cb = (await api('GET', '/v1/convoys')).body || {};
    const my = hb.mine, cv = cb.mine;
    t.innerHTML = `
      <h2>The Solo Score</h2>
      <div class="card"><div class="d">a one-man job - quick cash, shared cooldown with crew work</div>
        ${me.heistSeconds > 0 ? `<span class="chip cold">cooling ${mins(me.heistSeconds)}</span>` : '<button class="act" data-do="POST /v1/heist">pull it</button>'}</div>

      <h2 style="margin-top:12px">Crew Heists</h2>
      ${hb.you ? `<div class="card"><span class="t">YOUR JACKET</span>
        <span class="chip">${esc(hb.you.rank)}</span> <span class="d">${hb.you.pulled} score${hb.you.pulled === 1 ? '' : 's'} pulled</span>
        ${hb.you.hotLoot > 0 ? `<div style="margin-top:6px">?? <b>hot loot: $${fmt(hb.you.hotLoot)}</b> <span class="d">- fence it at today's rate (draws heat; a killer loots half if you're marked)</span>
          <button class="act" data-do="POST /v1/heists/fence"${groundOff('The fence')}>fence it</button></div>` : ''}</div>` : ''}
      ${my ? `
        <div class="card" style="border-color:var(--neon)">${aart('heist', (hb.jobs || []).find((jj) => jj.name === my.name)?.id)}<span class="t">${esc(my.name)}</span> <span class="chip">${my.leader ? 'YOUR JOB' : 'crewed up'}</span>${my.fenced ? ' <span class="chip" style="color:var(--warn)">?? HOT</span>' : ''}
          <div class="d">crew: ${my.crew.map((c) => `${esc(c.name)} (${c.role})${c.cased ? ' �cased' : ''}${c.hired ? ' ??hired' : ''}`).join(', ')}${my.crewNeeded > 0 ? ` � ${my.crewNeeded} seat${my.crewNeeded > 1 ? 's' : ''} open` : ' � READY'}</div>
          ${my.leader && my.canHire ? `<div class="d" style="font-size:12px;color:var(--dim)">no crew? hire a hand - $${fmt(my.fillFee)} up front. A hand fills a seat but takes a cut and earns you nothing extra.</div>

          ${my.leader ? `<button class="act" data-heistdo="execute:${my.id}" ${my.crewNeeded > 0 ? 'disabled' : ''}>EXECUTE</button>
            <button class="act" data-heistdo="leave:${my.id}">disband</button>` : `<button class="act" data-heistdo="leave:${my.id}">walk away</button>`}
          <button class="act" data-heistdo="rat:${my.id}" style="opacity:.55">.talk to the badges</button></div>` : `
        <div class="d" style="color:var(--dim);font-size:13.5px;margin-bottom:4px">plan one (you front the stake) or crew up off the board:</div>
        <img id="hj-preview" class="ico wide" alt="" src="/v1/art/heist/${(hb.jobs || [])[0]?.id || ''}" style="max-width:420px">
        <select id="hj-job">${(hb.jobs || []).map((jb) => { const lvlOk = (me?.level || 0) >= jb.lvl;
          // TWO gates, not one. `locked` is the notoriety soft-gate; `lvl` is the level wall the server
          // enforces in planHeist - and reading a requirement into the LABEL is not enforcing it. Every
          // sibling picker in the client (races tiers, convoy routes and rigs, port lanes) disables on
          // level with a ??; this one stated "lvl 4" beside a live option, so a level-1 player picked
          // The Corner Store, pressed plan it, and got refused. A control that looks live and only
          // refuses once pressed is the game withholding its own rule.
          return `<option value="${jb.id}"${jb.locked || !lvlOk ? ' disabled' : ''}>${lvlOk ? '' : '?? '}${esc(jb.name)} - ${jb.crew} crew, lvl ${jb.lvl}, stake $${fmt(jb.stake)}${jb.locked ? ` (needs ${jb.minPulled} scores)` : ''}</option>`; }).join('')}</select>

        <div class="d" style="font-size:11.5px;margin-top:2px">?? <a href="#" id="hj-lb">the most notorious crews </a></div>`}
      ${(hb.open || []).length ? `<div class="grid" style="margin-top:6px">${hb.open.map((o) => { const lvlOk = (me?.level || 0) >= o.lvl;
        // Same wall as the picker above, on the other way in: joinHeist enforces the job's level, so a
        // rookie who reads "lvl 4+" on somebody's open job and presses crew up gets refused. State it
        // as a wall, not as trivia.
        return `<div class="card">${aart('heist', (hb.jobs || []).find((jj) => jj.name === o.name)?.id)}<span class="t">${esc(o.name)}</span>
          <div class="d">${o.leader}'s job � ${o.crew} in, ${o.crewNeeded} needed � lvl ${o.lvl}+</div>
          ${!my && o.rolesOpen.length ? (!lvlOk ? `<span class="chip">?? you need level ${o.lvl}</span>`
            : o.canJoin === false ? '<span class="chip">not available to your street</span>'
              : `<select data-joinrole="${o.id}">${o.rolesOpen.map((ro) => `<option>${ro}</option>`).join('')}</select>
          <button class="act" data-joinheist="${o.id}">crew up</button>`) : ''}</div>`; }).join('')}</div>` : ''}

      <h2 style="margin-top:12px">Smuggling Convoys</h2>
      ${cb.legend ? `<div class="card" style="border-color:var(--gold,#c9a227)"><span class="t">?? ${cb.legend.hauler} � ?? ${cb.legend.bandit}</span>
        <div class="d">delivered clean $${fmt(cb.legend.delivered || 0)} � hijacked off the roads $${fmt(cb.legend.hijacked || 0)} <span style="color:var(--dim)">(survives death)</span> � <a href="#" id="cv-lb">?? the roads </a></div>
        ${cb.roadBoss || cb.teamsterOfWeek ? `<div class="d">${cb.roadBoss ? `?? ROAD BOSS this week: <b>${esc(cb.roadBoss.name)}</b> ($${fmt(cb.roadBoss.value)})` : ''}${cb.roadBoss && cb.teamsterOfWeek ? ' � ' : ''}${cb.teamsterOfWeek ? `?? TEAMSTER OF THE WEEK: <b>${esc(cb.teamsterOfWeek.name)}</b> ($${fmt(cb.teamsterOfWeek.value)})` : ''}</div>` : ''}
        ${cb.reputation ? `<div class="d">running the same lane heats it (bandits case it  weaker guards) - vary lanes to stay cool. ${(cb.reputation.coolsFaster || cb.reputation.tollBreak || cb.reputation.quieter) ? `<span class="chip" style="color:var(--gold)">reputation: ${[cb.reputation.coolsFaster && 'lanes cool 2x faster', cb.reputation.tollBreak && 'toll halved', cb.reputation.quieter && 'low profile'].filter(Boolean).join(' � ')}</span>` : '<span class="chip">earn the Teamster ranks to manage lane heat</span>'}</div>` : ''}
        <div id="cv-lbout"></div></div>` : ''}
      ${cb.rig ? `<div class="card"><span class="t">THE RIG - ${esc(cb.rig.name)}</span> <span class="chip">?? armor ${cb.rig.armorLvl}/${cb.rig.max}</span> <span class="chip">? engine ${cb.rig.engineLvl}/${cb.rig.max}</span>
        <div class="d">+${cb.rig.armorDef} guard defense � -${(cb.rig.speedBps / 100).toFixed(0)}% transit</div>

  // �� GOING LEGIT: the Portfolio - earned $OMR into legit, death-proof RWA holdings ��
  async function renderPortfolio() {
    const t = $('#tab-portfolio');
    t.setAttribute('aria-busy', 'true');
    if (!t.querySelector('#capital-overview')) t.innerHTML = `
      <section class="capital-desk" role="status" aria-live="polite">
        <div class="capital-desk__head"><div><span class="capital-desk__eyebrow">$OMR / capital operations</span>
          <h2 class="capital-desk__title">Reading the books.</h2><p class="capital-desk__lede">Checking launch, market, reserve and wallet state.</p></div></div>
      </section>`;
    await refresh();
    // eight serial awaits before a single pixel painted. Issuing them together doesn't make the
    // AUTHED ones concurrent (api() queues those on purpose - same-account calls serialize on the
    // character row at the database anyway), but it removes the client-side turnaround between each
    // response and the next request, and the keyless boards genuinely do run in parallel.
    // (D11 2026-08-05: the stock book retired - /v1/portfolio and its boards are tombstones now;
    // this screen is the REAL money arc: made  ladder  wallet  extraction  window  vault  bonds)
    const [vaultR, deskR, bdR, winR, yldR, wdR, bkR, bkrR, drR, pvR, identityR] = await Promise.all([
      api('GET', '/v1/vault'), api('GET', '/v1/desk'), api('GET', '/v1/bonds'),
      api('GET', '/v1/window'), api('GET', '/v1/yield'),
      api('GET', '/v1/withdraw/status'), api('GET', '/v1/bank'),
      api('GET', '/v1/brokers'), api('GET', '/v1/drop'),
      api('GET', '/v1/provenance'),
      api('GET', '/v1/identity/readiness'),
    ]);
    const fgR = await api('GET', '/v1/forge');
    const identity = identityR.code === 200 && identityR.body?.ready ? identityR.body : null;
    const characterPendingKey = identity && me.wallet ? `omerta-character-fee:${identity.accountId}:0x${identity.chainId.toString(16)}:${me.wallet.toLowerCase()}:${identity.feesContract.toLowerCase()}` : null;
    const characterPendingHash = characterPendingKey ? localStorage.getItem(characterPendingKey) : null;
    const readFailureCount = [vaultR, deskR, bdR, winR, yldR, wdR, bkR, bkrR, drR, pvR, fgR]
      .filter((r) => Number(r?.code) >= 400).length;
    const fg = fgR.body || {};
    const vault = vaultR.body || {}, desk = deskR.body || {}, bd = bdR.body || {};
    const win = winR.body || {}, yld = yldR.body || {};
    const wd = wdR.body || {}, bk = bkR.body || {};
    const bkr = bkrR.body || {};
    const dr = drR.body || {};
    const pv = pvR.body || {};
    const genesis = desk.genesis || bd.genesis || {};
    const launchSteps = [
      ['prepare', 'Prepare'], ['auction', 'Auction'], ['migration', 'Migrate'],
      ['oracle_warmup', 'Warm oracle'], ['live', 'Market live'],
    ];
    const phaseIndex = launchSteps.findIndex(([id]) => id === genesis.phase);
    const launchProgress = ({ legacy: 0, prepare: 12, auction: 40, migration: 66, oracle_warmup: 84, live: 100, failed: 0 })[genesis.phase] ?? 0;
    const phaseLabel = ({
      legacy: 'not armed', prepare: 'preparing launch', auction: 'initial auction live', migration: 'seeding liquidity',
      oracle_warmup: 'warming the oracle', live: 'canonical market live', failed: 'launch halted',
    })[genesis.phase] || 'status unavailable';

  // data-do buttons (POST/GET; an optional data-body='{...}' rides along).
  // A button may also carry data-confirm="Title|the consequence" - most of the irreversible verbs
  // in the game are declarative data-do buttons, so the guard has to live here rather than being
  // hand-wired at each site (and a missing attribute means "no confirm", which is the old behaviour).
  document.addEventListener('click', async (e) => {
    const btn = e.target?.closest?.('[data-do]'); if (!btn) return;
    const d = btn.dataset.do;
    const [m, p] = d.split(' ');
    let body = m === 'GET' ? undefined : {};
    if (btn.dataset.body) { try { body = JSON.parse(btn.dataset.body); } catch { /* keep {} */ } }
    if (btn.dataset.confirm) {
      const [title, ...rest] = btn.dataset.confirm.split('|');
      if (!await ask(title, rest.join('|'), { yes: btn.dataset.confirmYes || 'do it', danger: true })) return;
    }
    act(m, p, body);
  });

  // �� the wire (websocket feed) - HUMAN lines only, color-coded by what happened.
  // (founder: the feed must never show raw JSON, and actions read at a glance by color) ��
  // (red-team R6) complete HTML escaper for player-controlled strings rendered into innerHTML -
  // defense-in-depth over the server-side cleanText() strip (covers & and the attribute quotes too).
  const esc = (s) => String(s == null ? '' : s).replace(/[&<>"']/g, (c) => ({ '&': '&amp;', '<': '&lt;', '>': '&gt;', '"': '&quot;', "'": '&#39;' }[c]));
  const escapeHtml = esc;
  // category  color: combat red � law blue � den/vice purple � racing/fights yellow �
  // money/market green � family gold � world cyan � info/movement grey
  const FEED_CAT = [
    [/^(kill|jump|shank|bounty|whack|war|seize|vendetta|standover|convoy_hijack|port_piracy|npchit|attack|took_bullet|guard|breakout$)/, 'combat'],
    [/^(bust|indicted|raid|law|escape|breakout_foiled|busted)/, 'law'],
    [/^(highroller|numbers|fight|dice|poker|tourney|track|futurity|casino|den|blackjack)/, 'den'],
    [/^(gp_|match_race|race|stable|boxing|belt|fights|callout)/, 'race'],
    [/^(market|sale|port_landing|port_fence|heist_score|order|auction|paper|loan|flex)/, 'market'],
    [/^(tribute|family|gang|weekly|commission|crest|seal|foundation)/, 'family'],
    [/^(world|frontier|cartel|uprising|liberated)/, 'world'],
    [/^(vice|speakeasy)/, 'den'],
    [/^(crime|score)/, 'crime'],
  ];
  const FEED_COLOR = { combat: '#e05252', law: '#5aa7e0', den: '#c07ae8', race: '#e0cf5a', market: '#5ad489',
    family: '#d4af37', world: '#5ac9c9', crime: '#e8a54b', move: 'var(--dim)', info: 'var(--dim)', chat: 'var(--fg)' };
  const catOf = (ev) => {
    if (ev.cat) return ev.cat;
    const t = String(ev.type || '');
    for (const [re, c] of FEED_CAT) if (re.test(t)) return c;
    return 'info';
  };
  // one honest sentence per event - templates for the big ones, a field-stitcher for the rest,
  // NEVER raw JSON. Live `me` events carry fields under .payload; streets events are flat.
  function feedText(ev) {
    const d = ev.payload && typeof ev.payload === 'object' ? { ...ev.payload, type: ev.type } : ev;
    const t = String(d.type || '');
    const $c = (n) => (n == null ? '' : '$' + fmt(n));
    const $d = (id) => (rules?.districts || []).find((x) => x.id === id)?.name || id;
    const T = {
      act: () => `${d.who} ${d.text}`,
      kill: () => `${d.by} whacked ${d.victim}`,
      jump: () => `${d.by} jumped ${d.on}${d.war ? ' - war points' : ''}`,
      // THE STREET WAR - asset crimes (victim notifies + streets shouts; the notify names the attacker)
      robbed: () => `${d.from} hit the register at your ${d.kindName || d.kind} - skimmed ${$c(d.cut)}`,
      rob_failed: () => `${d.from} tried to rob your ${d.kindName || d.kind} - security had them pinched`,
      car_stolen: () => `${d.from} stole your ${d.name || d.model} right off the street`,
      car_theft_failed: () => `${d.from} got caught trying to boost your car`,
      trunk_robbed: () => `${d.from} mugged ${d.qty} x ${goodName(d.good)} out of your trunk`,
      trunk_rob_failed: () => `${d.from} tried to mug your freight - pinched`,
      boat_stolen: () => `${d.from} slipped your ${d.kindName || d.kind} off its moorings`,
      boat_theft_failed: () => `${d.from} got caught on your gangway`,
      sabotaged: () => `${d.from} wrecked your ${d.what} ${d.name} - laid up for hours`,
      sabotage_failed: () => `${d.from} was caught creeping your stable`,
      rob: () => `${d.by} hit the register at ${d.on}'s ${d.kind}`,
      car_theft: () => `${d.by} boosted a car off ${d.on}`,
      trunk_rob: () => `${d.by} mugged the freight off ${d.on}'s back`,
      boat_theft: () => `${d.by} stole a boat off ${d.on}'s berth`,
      sabotage: () => `${d.by} wrecked something in ${d.on}'s stable`,
      // STREET DEEDS Phase 2 - the corner shakedown (the deed owner is notified)
      corner_seized: () => `${d.from} muscled in on your corner at ${d.street} - they collect the take until you take it back`,
      corner_defended: () => `${d.from} tried to lean on your corner at ${d.street} - you held it`,
      deed_sold: () => `you sold ${d.street} to ${d.to} for ${$c(d.price)}`,
      bounty: () => `a ${$c(d.amount)} ${d.kind === 'kill' ? 'KILL' : 'hospital'} contract is out on ${d.on}`,
      bust: () => `${d.by} busted ${d.freed} out of lockup`,
      // THREE shapes on one type - the streets shout `{who}`, a RICO conviction `{forfeited,
      // jailSeconds}`, and a JAILBREAK `{from}`, which is somebody springing YOU. Written for the
      // streets shape alone it told a freed player "undefined got hauled in" - the opposite of what
      // happened. Branch on the shape, never on the channel (feedText doesn't get one).
      busted: () => (d.from ? `${d.from} sprang you out of lockup - you're on the street`
        : d.forfeited != null ? `CONVICTED - ${$c(d.forfeited)} forfeited, ${minsTxt(d.jailSeconds)} inside`
        : `${d.who} got hauled in`),
