      rerolled: () => `a new hand dealt - your build is re-rolled`,
      forged: () => `the ledger speaks - ${d.name ? `born ${d.name}` : 'a build rolled from an unknown hand'}${d.bonus ? ` (+${d.bonus} on the strong suit)` : ''}${d.budgetExtra ? ` (+${d.budgetExtra} to the budget)` : ''}${d.affinity ? ` � schooled in ${d.affinity.name || d.affinity.discipline}` : ''}`,
      fee_credited: () => `your ${String(d.kind || '').replace(/_/g, ' ')} payment landed`,
      store_grant: () => `${d.name} is yours`,
      // �� the world
      world_raid_fail: () => `${art(d.npc, 'The')} held - their guns put you in hospital`,
      // �� the ones the field-stitcher could not reach. It stitches `who`/`by`/`on`/`victim`, and
      // these carry `from`/`guard`/`killer` instead - so a MURDERED player's wire read the single
      // word "whacked", and a kill contract on your head read "bounty on you". (Several already had
      // a sentence in THE MORNING PAPER's own map, which is how one surface could describe an event
      // the other could not.)
      whacked: () => `${d.from} PUT YOU IN THE GROUND - your line goes on without you`,
      attack: () => `${d.from} jumped you${d.stolen ? ` - took ${$c(d.stolen)}` : ''}${d.cb ? ` and ${d.cb} crates` : ''}`,
      attempt: () => `${d.from} came at you and got nothing but knuckles`,
      took_bullet: () => `you took the bullet meant for ${d.for}`,
      guard_saved_you: () => `${d.guard} stepped in front of it - you're still standing`,
      target_guarded: () => `${d.victim} had ${d.guard} on them - the shot went into the bodyguard`,
      bodyguard_hired: () => `${d.by} put you on the payroll - ${$c(d.price)} for ${d.hours}h`,
      bounty_on_you: () => `THERE'S A ${d.kind === 'kill' ? 'KILL' : 'HOSPITAL'} CONTRACT ON YOUR HEAD - ${$c(d.amount)}`,
      contract_offer: () => `you've been named on a ${d.kind === 'kill' ? 'kill' : 'hospital'} contract for ${d.target} - ${$c(d.amount)}`,
      npchit_survived: () => `somebody paid to have you killed and the shooter missed - insure yourself`,
      witness: () => `you saw ${d.killer} put ${d.victim} down`,
      witness_down: () => `the witness against you is gone`,
      hitman_rank: () => `they call you ${d.title} now - ${d.rep} in the book`,
      sacked: () => (d.by ? `${d.by} took ${d.on}'s ${d.front} off the corpse`
        : `you took ${d.name} off ${d.from}'s corpse - the ${d.kind} is yours now`),
      sale: () => `${d.what} sold to ${d.to} - ${$c(d.amt)}`,
      post_given: () => `you're the family's ${d.name} now`,
      contest_resolved: () => (d.won ? `you took ${$d(d.district)} - ${$c(d.staked)} staked`
        : `${d.winner || 'another family'} took ${$d(d.district)} - ${$c(d.back)} of your ${$c(d.staked)} came back`),
      feud_peace_offer: () => `${d.from}'s line is suing for peace`,
      feud_peace_made: () => `the blood between you and ${d.with}'s line is settled`,
      wire_alert: () => `your wire on ${d.name} - ${d.event === 'hunting_you' ? "they're hunting YOU" : d.event === 'wanted' ? "they've gone WANTED" : 'the Bureau indicted them'}`,
      heist_abandoned: () => `the ${d.job} is off - ${d.reason === 'leader_dead' ? 'the man running it is dead' : 'it fell apart'}`,
      break_abandoned: () => `the break is off - ${d.reason === 'leader_dead' ? 'the man running it is dead' : 'it fell apart'}`,
      raid_abandoned: () => `the raid is off - ${d.reason === 'leader_dead' ? 'the man running it is dead' : 'it fell apart'}`,
      chat: () => `${d.who}: ${d.text}`,
    };
    if (T[t]) { try { return T[t](); } catch { /* fall through */ } }
    const who = d.who || d.by || d.name || d.gang || d.family || d.winner || '';
    const tgt = d.on || d.victim || d.target || '';
    return [who, t.replace(/_/g, ' '), tgt].filter(Boolean).join(' ') || t.replace(/_/g, ' ');
  }
  // THE URGENT TIER - threats and money-at-risk get a distinct rendering so the one channel a player
  // actually watches means something (a kill order and a tribute tick used to arrive at equal volume).
  // Curated VICTIM-side types only (things happening TO you that want a response), never ambient news.
  // `sacked` is deliberately NOT here: this set's own rule is victim-side threats that want a
  // response, and the only `sacked` notify goes to the KILLER - it is a win, not a threat.
  const URGENT_TYPES = new Set(['bounty_on_you', 'indicted', 'extortion', 'npc_aggression',
    'family_retaliation', 'robbed', 'car_stolen', 'trunk_robbed', 'boat_stolen', 'sabotaged',
    'inside_job', 'loan_defaulted', 'loan_forfeited', 'vendetta', 'exposed', 'whacked', 'pact_broken',
    'protege_attacked']);
  function feedLine(channel, ev) {
    if (channel === 'hello') { statusLine('- you are on the wire -'); return; }
    // (F2) the estate report flows through here on death (backfill on load, or the gen-bump re-backfill)
    // - pop the death/heir modal from it (deduped per generation inside showDeath).
    if (channel === 'me' && ev && ev.type === 'estate') showDeath(ev);
    // THE AHA MOMENT - the scripted first rival's move (live or backfilled)  the cinematic beat.
    if (channel === 'me' && ev && ev.type === 'first_blood') showFirstBlood(ev.payload || {});
    // THE RESULTS SHOW - a marquee event you staked on resolved. A WIN gets the payoff beat (the win
    // sting + a celebratory toast); a loss/scratch just rides the feed line below. No modal - the wire
    // + the toast are the moment, so a backfill of several results can't stack into modal fatigue.
    if (channel === 'me' && ev && ev.type === 'event_result') {
      const p = ev.payload || {};
      if (p.outcome === 'won') { haptic('big'); sfx('win'); toast(`${p.icon || '??'} ${p.headline} - you took $${fmt(p.payout)}`, false); }
    }
    // THE CHAMPION'S MOMENT - you didn't just bet on a marquee event, you WON one. A distinct, bigger
    // cinematic than a bettor's win sting: the entrant who took first place / the belt gets the poster.
    if (channel === 'me' && ev && championCine(ev.type, ev.payload || {})) {
      const c = championCine(ev.type, ev.payload || {});
      haptic('big'); sfx('win');
      playCine({ kicker: c.kicker, title: c.title, sub: c.sub, accent: 'var(--gold)', fx: 'payday', clip: 'cine-champion.mp4', hold: 2400 });
    }
    // THE CONVERGENCE NUDGE - a real human walked into a district. Only act on it when it's YOUR
    // district and it isn't you: a quiet presence toast (not a feed line - for everyone else it's
    // noise). Presence is public, so this leaks nothing the /v1/live board doesn't already show.
    if (channel === 'streets' && ev && ev.type === 'arrival') {
      if (me && ev.district === me.loc && ev.cid !== me.id) {
        const dn = (rules?.districts || []).find((d) => d.id === ev.district)?.name || ev.district;
        toast(`?? ${esc(ev.who)} just showed up in ${esc(dn)}`, false);
        if (currentTab === 'start') renderActive();
      }
      return;
    }
    if (channel === 'me' && ev && ev.type === 'dm') phoneRing(ev.payload || {});
    if (channel === 'chat' || (channel === 'gang' && ev.type === 'chat')) { chatLine(channel === 'chat' ? 'city' : 'family', ev); return; }
    const f = $('#feed');
    const cat = channel === 'gang' ? 'family' : catOf(ev);
    const color = FEED_COLOR[cat] || 'var(--dim)';
    const mine = channel === 'me';
    const urgent = mine && URGENT_TYPES.has(ev.type);
    const line = el(`<div class="ev fresh ${mine ? 'me' : ''}${urgent ? ' urgent' : ''}" data-cat="${cat}"><span class="dot" style="color:${urgent ? 'var(--bad)' : color}">?</span> ` +
      `<span style="color:${mine ? 'var(--fg)' : color}">${esc(feedText(ev))}</span></div>`);
    f.prepend(line);
    setTimeout(() => line.classList.remove('fresh'), 1600); // the neon wash is one-shot; drop it so re-renders don't re-flash
    while (f.childElementCount > 120) f.lastElementChild.remove();
  }
  // THE FEED FILTER - mute a category so the wire reads as signal, not noise. A muted group hangs a
  // hide-<group> class on #feed (CSS hides its data-cat lines); the muted set persists in localStorage.
  const FEED_GROUPS = ['combat', 'law', 'money', 'family', 'world'];
  function applyFeedFilter() {
    const muted = new Set((localStorage.getItem('omerta_feedmute') || '').split(',').filter(Boolean));
    const f = $('#feed');
    if (f) for (const g of FEED_GROUPS) f.classList.toggle('hide-' + g, muted.has(g));
    document.querySelectorAll('#feedfilter .ffchip').forEach((c) => c.classList.toggle('muted', muted.has(c.dataset.fgroup)));
  }
  function wireFeedFilter() {
    document.querySelectorAll('#feedfilter .ffchip').forEach((c) => c.onclick = () => {
      const muted = new Set((localStorage.getItem('omerta_feedmute') || '').split(',').filter(Boolean));
      if (muted.has(c.dataset.fgroup)) muted.delete(c.dataset.fgroup); else muted.add(c.dataset.fgroup);
      localStorage.setItem('omerta_feedmute', [...muted].join(','));
      applyFeedFilter();
    });
    applyFeedFilter();
  }
  // THE CITY PULSE - one honest, world-flagged line about today's REAL deterministic conditions (the
  // season twist, the trade-winds spread) so a low-population wire still feels like an inhabited city.
  // Once per day, filterable under 'world' - never a fabricated player or event (the population rule).
  async function cityPulse() {
    const dayKey = 'omerta_pulse_' + Math.floor(Date.now() / 86400000);
    if (localStorage.getItem(dayKey)) return;                 // once a day, not every load
    let c; try { c = (await api('GET', '/v1/city')).body; } catch { return; }
    if (!c) return;
    const bits = [];
    if (c.season?.mod && c.season.mod.id !== 'dead_quiet' && c.season.mod.name)
      bits.push(`the season turns - ${c.season.mod.name}`);
    const shocks = Object.entries(c.weather || {}).map(([d, x]) => [d, Number(x)]).sort((a, b) => a[1] - b[1]);
    if (shocks.length >= 2) {
      const cheap = shocks[0], rich = shocks[shocks.length - 1];
      const pct = Math.round((rich[1] / cheap[1] - 1) * 100);
      if (pct >= 4) bits.push(`word is goods run ~${pct}% cheaper in ${cheap[0]} than ${rich[0]} today`);
    }
    if (!bits.length) return;
    localStorage.setItem(dayKey, '1');
    const f = $('#feed'); if (!f) return;
    const line = el(`<div class="ev fresh" data-cat="world"><span class="dot" style="color:${FEED_COLOR.world}">?</span> <span style="color:${FEED_COLOR.world}">?? ${esc(bits.join(' � '))}</span></div>`);
    f.prepend(line);
    setTimeout(() => line.classList.remove('fresh'), 1600);
    applyFeedFilter();
  }
  function statusLine(text) {
    const f = $('#feed');
    f.prepend(el(`<div class="ev" style="color:var(--dim)">${esc(text)}</div>`));
  }

  // �� the troll box (public city chat + the family room) ��
  let wtab = 'feed';
  const chatDrafts = { city: '', family: '' };
  let chatSending = false;
  function chatLine(room, ev) {
    const pane = $(room === 'city' ? '#chat-city' : '#chat-family');
    if (!pane) return;
    // Stay with the reader when they scroll back; only follow new lines from the bottom.
    const follow = pane.scrollHeight - pane.scrollTop - pane.clientHeight < 48;
    pane.querySelector('[data-chat-state]')?.remove();
    pane.append(el(`<div class="ev"><b style="color:${room === 'family' ? 'var(--gold, #d4af37)' : 'var(--neon)'}">${esc(ev.who)}</b> <span>${esc(ev.text)}</span></div>`));
    while (pane.childElementCount > 120) pane.firstElementChild.remove();
    if (follow) pane.scrollTop = pane.scrollHeight;
  }
  async function loadChat(room) {
    const pane = $(room === 'city' ? '#chat-city' : '#chat-family');
    if (!pane) return;
    pane.setAttribute('aria-busy', 'true');
    if (!pane.childElementCount) pane.innerHTML = '<p class="dim" data-chat-state>Opening the line.</p>';
    const r = await api('GET', room === 'family' ? '/v1/gangs/chat' : '/v1/chat');
    pane.setAttribute('aria-busy', 'false');
    if (r.code >= 400 || !Array.isArray(r.body?.messages)) {
      if (!pane.querySelector('.ev')) {
        pane.innerHTML = r.body?.error === 'no_gang'
          ? '<p class="dim" data-chat-state>Join a family to use the family room.</p>'
          : '<div data-chat-state><p class="dim" role="status">The line could not be loaded. Try opening it again.</p><button type="button" class="act" data-chat-retry>retry</button></div>';
        pane.querySelector('[data-chat-retry]')?.addEventListener('click', () => loadChat(room));
      }
      return;
    }
    pane.innerHTML = '';
    for (const m of r.body.messages) chatLine(room, m);
    if (!r.body.messages.length) pane.innerHTML = '<p class="dim" data-chat-state>No messages yet. The line is open.</p>';
    pane.scrollTop = pane.scrollHeight;
  }
  document.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
    const b = e.target?.closest?.('[data-wtab]'); if (!b) return;
    if (wtab !== 'feed') chatDrafts[wtab] = $('#chatinput').value;
    wtab = b.dataset.wtab;
    $$('#wiretabs .wtab').forEach((t) => {
      const on = t === b;
      t.classList.toggle('on', on);
      t.setAttribute('aria-selected', String(on));
      t.tabIndex = on ? 0 : -1;
    });
    $('#feed').classList.toggle('hidden', wtab !== 'feed');
    $('#chat-city').classList.toggle('hidden', wtab !== 'city');
    $('#chat-family').classList.toggle('hidden', wtab !== 'family');
    $('#chatform').classList.toggle('hidden', wtab === 'feed');
    $('#chatinput').placeholder = wtab === 'family' ? T('w_famonly') : T('w_sayit');
    $('#chatinput').setAttribute('aria-label', wtab === 'family' ? 'Message to family chat' : 'Message to city chat');
    $('#chatinput').value = chatDrafts[wtab] || '';
    if (wtab !== 'feed') loadChat(wtab);
  });
  $('#wiretabs')?.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
    if (!['ArrowLeft', 'ArrowRight', 'Home', 'End'].includes(e.key)) return;
    const items = $$('#wiretabs [role="tab"]').filter((node) => !node.classList.contains('hidden') && !node.disabled);
    if (!items.length) return;
    const at = Math.max(0, items.indexOf(document.activeElement));
    const next = e.key === 'Home' ? items[0] : e.key === 'End' ? items[items.length - 1]
      : items[(at + (e.key === 'ArrowRight' ? 1 : -1) + items.length) % items.length];
    e.preventDefault(); next.focus(); next.click();
  });
  $('#chatform')?.addEventListener('submit', async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    const input = $('#chatinput'), draft = input.value, text = draft.trim(), room = wtab;
    if (!text || chatSending || room === 'feed') return;
    const form = $('#chatform'), send = form.querySelector('[type="submit"]');
    chatDrafts[room] = draft;
    chatSending = true;
    form.setAttribute('aria-busy', 'true'); send.disabled = true; send.textContent = 'sending.';
    try {
      const r = await api('POST', room === 'family' ? '/v1/gangs/chat' : '/v1/chat', { text });
      if (r.code === 400 && r.body?.error === 'no_gang') toast('join a family before using its room - your draft is saved', true);
      else if (r.body?.error === 'slow_down' || r.code === 429) toast('wait a moment before sending again - your draft is saved', true);
      else if (r.code >= 400) toast('the message was not confirmed - your draft is saved; check the line before retrying', true);
      else {
        if (chatDrafts[room] === draft) chatDrafts[room] = '';
        if (wtab === room && input.value === draft) input.value = '';
      }
    } catch {
      toast('the message was not confirmed - your draft is saved; check the line before retrying', true);
    } finally {
      chatSending = false;
      form.setAttribute('aria-busy', 'false'); send.disabled = false; send.textContent = T('b_send');
    }
  });

  // �� presence: who's on the wire (polled with the sheet refresh) ��
  async function pollOnline() {
    try {
      const r = await fetch('/v1/online').then((x) => x.json());
      const n = r.active15m || r.online || 0;
      $('#online-badge').textContent = `? ${n} ${T('w_incity')}`;
    } catch { /* offline */ }
  }

  // �� the cooldown ticker: every [data-until] element live-counts down to READY ��
  function tickCooldowns() {
    const now = Date.now();
    let crossed = false;
    for (const n of $$('[data-until]')) {
      const left = Math.max(0, Math.floor((Number(n.dataset.until) - now) / 1000));
      if (left <= 0) {
        if (!n.classList.contains('cd-ready')) crossed = true;   // it hit zero on THIS tick
        n.textContent = n.dataset.ready || 'READY'; n.classList.add('cd-ready'); continue;
      }
      const h = Math.floor(left / 3600), m = Math.floor((left % 3600) / 60), s = left % 60;
      n.textContent = h > 0 ? `${h}h ${m}m` : m > 0 ? `${m}:${String(s).padStart(2, '0')}` : `${s}s`;
    }
    // A countdown reaching zero is the ONE moment a board genuinely goes stale, and the board poll
    // being decoupled from the sheet made it worse: this ticker repaints TEXT, but whether the
    // button beside it is disabled (or rendered at all) was decided by the render that drew it - so
    // the clock would read READY next to a dead button for up to BOARD_EVERY ticks. That is a
    // control that lies, so the crossing re-renders the open screen itself. It is rare (only when a
    // clock actually expires), it is debounced and type-safe through renderActive, and it leaves the
    // case a player is actually watching FRESHER than the every-tick poll it replaced.
    if (crossed && me && !document.hidden) renderActive();
  }
  setInterval(tickCooldowns, 1000);
  // helper for renderers: a live countdown span from a seconds-remaining number
  const cd = (seconds, ready) => Number(seconds) > 0
    ? `<span class="cdt" data-until="${Date.now() + Number(seconds) * 1000}"${ready ? ` data-ready="${esc(ready)}"` : ''}></span>`
    : `<span class="cdt cd-ready">${ready || 'READY'}</span>`;
  // (bulletproof audit, Exponential Backoff) a fixed 4s retry makes every open tab re-dial IN STEP after a
  // server restart - a reconnect herd of simultaneous WS upgrades at exactly the moment the box is coldest.
  // Jittered exponential backoff (2s � 1.6^n, capped 30s, �30% jitter) spreads the herd; reset on a
  // successful open so an ordinary blip still reconnects fast.
  let wsRetries = 0;
  const wsRetryMs = () => {
    const base = Math.min(30000, 2000 * Math.pow(1.6, wsRetries));
    return Math.round(base * (0.7 + Math.random() * 0.6));
  };
  function connectWs() {
    if (ws || !token || projections.snapshot().token !== token) return;
    const socketToken = token;
    try {
      const proto = location.protocol === 'https:' ? 'wss' : 'ws';
      // (red-team R12 F2) pass the session JWT as a subprotocol value, NOT in the URL - a WS URL lands in
      // access/proxy logs + browser history, and this is the same full bearer token ( account takeover).
      const socket = new WebSocket(`${proto}://${location.host}/v1/ws`, ['bearer', token]);
      ws = socket;
      socket.onopen = () => { if (ws !== socket || token !== socketToken) return; wsRetries = 0; const d = $('#ws-dot'); d.style.color = 'var(--ok)'; d.classList.add('live'); pollOnline(); projections.world(worldSelection, worldMysterySelection); };
      socket.onmessage = (m) => {
        try {
          if (ws !== socket || token !== socketToken || projections.snapshot().token !== token) return;
          const ev = JSON.parse(m.data);
          if (ev.channel === 'projection') {
            if (ev.changed === true) projections.world(worldSelection, worldMysterySelection);
            return;
          }
          feedLine(ev.channel || '?', ev);
          // CONTEXTUAL PUSH OPT-IN - a LIVE urgent event (a contract on your head, a body, an
          // indictment) is the moment alerts obviously matter. Ask once; backfilled history never
          // triggers it (this is the socket path only). first_blood's own beat asks separately.
          if (ev.channel === 'me' && URGENT_TYPES.has(ev.type)) maybeAskPush('The city just made a move on you.');
          // your own events refresh the sheet + re-render the open board; streets/gang events
          // (someone posted a contract, a club got raided) just re-render the open board.
          if (ev.channel === 'me') { refresh(); renderActive(); }
          else renderActive();
        } catch { /* noise */ }
      };
      socket.onclose = () => { if (ws !== socket) return; const d = $('#ws-dot'); d.style.color = 'var(--bad)'; d.classList.remove('live'); ws = null;
        if (token === socketToken && projections.snapshot().token === token) { wsRetries++; setTimeout(connectWs, wsRetryMs()); } };
    } catch { /* headless */ }
  }

  applyI18n();
  mountLangPicker('#top');           // the console picker (persists; reload re-renders everything)
  mountLangPicker('#screen-auth .lfoot'); // the landing picker for first-time visitors
  boot();
})();
</script>
</body>

   64: export async function characterCheckout(pool, accountId, client, purpose = 'creation') {

   68:   const existingEntitlement = ctx.account.minted || Number(ctx.account.mint_credits) > 0;
   69:   if (existingEntitlement && purpose !== 'reveal') throw new GameError('already', 'Your account or character credit is ready. Claim the trophy for no fee; artwork reveal is an optional separate payment.');
   70:   if (!existingEntitlement && purpose === 'reveal') throw new GameError('invalid', 'Use character creation checkout first.');
   71:   const fee = await ctx.client.readContract({ address: ctx.fees, abi: readAbi('mintFee', 'uint256'), functionName: 'mintFee' });
   72:   if (fee <= 0n) throw new GameError('unavailable', 'Character creation fee is unavailable.');
   73:   const feeRecipient = await ctx.client.readContract({ address: ctx.fees, abi: readAbi('feeRecipient', 'address'), functionName: 'feeRecipient' });
